༄༅// bla ma rgyal ba rgyal sras bstan srung nor lha rnams la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba gsol ba gdab pa sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas gsar bskrun rnams kyi dkar chag bsngo ba smon lam bsdoms pa phun tshogs sde bzhi'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// swasti/ bskal pa bzang po'i rgyal ba'i sras// kun las thugs bskyed smon lam stobs// bsgrun du med pas snyigs ma 'dir// 'tshang rgya bgyis pa shākya'i tog /gang dang phyogs bcu'i lus med thul// sras dang bcas la phyag bgyis nas// stong gsum lha mi'i dpal 'byor dang*// bdag lus longs spyod bcas pas mchod// rang bzhin bcas pa'i dkar min las// bgyis gang stobs bzhi'i cho gas bshags// 'khor 'das dge ba'i rgya mtsho la// 'dzum dkar zla ba'i zer gyis bran// 'gro ba'i sgron ma mchog rnams la// zhi bder mi mnal 'tsho gzhes bskul// chos kyi gling bu brtul ba rnams// legs gsungs 'doms par gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams chu klung 'bab po 'tshal// byang chub rgya mtsho rgyas phyir bsngo// rgyal ba'i ring lugs nor bu'i tog /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtser 'god cing*// dge legs rdzogs ldan 'gugs pa'i dpal// rgyal tshab dpal ldan chos skyong zhes// gang de'i mdzad pa'i chu gter las// ngo mtshar rten dang brten pa'i mdzod// gan+dho la yi zla snang gis// srid pa'i gdung ba thag ring byas// de yi rten gtso bu ram shing*// thub chen sku brnyan mthong don ni// bsod nams srid rtser lud 'gyur zhing*// bkra shis dpal 'byung nor bu gang*// mdzes byed dar gyi snyan shal 'di// thub dbang chos kyi sgor zhugs nas// ngur smrig rtags su blangs pa'i ming*// tshul khrims rin chen zhes byas phul// dge tshogs dbyar gyi dpal mo yis// bsu ba phan bde'i lo 'dab can// don gnyis snye ma g.yur za ba'i// byang chub ljon pa bdag gyur cig

/de srid skye bar dal 'byor ldan// gtsug lag kun la blo mig grungs// thub pa'i gsung gi mdzad bzung nas// legs bshad snang chen 'gyed par shog /yul gru yul gyi dam pas mtshon// kun tu kun mkhyen e waṃ pa'i// chos dang chos smra dge 'dun sde// gong nas gong du rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes mkhan po rin po che dpal ldan chos skyong zhal snga nas/ skye sku don grub gling gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa'i rab gnas kyi tshe/ thub chen sku brnyan la kho bos snyan shal 'bul ba'i mchod bsngor bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ mkhyen brtse zung gi spyan ras srid dang zhi'i// mtha' gnyis 'gong bar spros pa'i lam nyid du// skye bo'i tshogs kyi ngal gso bla na med// thub pa'i rgyal tshab e waṃ pa des skyongs// mu dang mthas dben phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi// lus phra'i 'gram dkyus yangs par brdal ba'i zhing*// kun du 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs// de sras gdung 'tshob slob mar bcas pa rnams// 'di nas bla na med pa'i byang chub bar// bsod nams tshogs kyi zhing du nyer bzung ba'i// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang gi bla mas mtshon// bdag sogs grangs med lus kyis btud phyag 'tshal// stong ku'i sgeg mos thags bskrun bla re dang*// yol bas nyer mtshon mchod pa kun gyi mchod// srid pa'i 'khor lor bsags pa'i sdig ltung mthol// 'gro ba'i dge la yi rang 'dzum gyis bran// phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba 'dul mchog thams cad la// myang 'das bde ba'i bdud rtsir ma chags par// chos min 'pham pa'i chos rnga cher brdung bas// khams gsum ma rig gnyid las bsang bar gsol// des bskyed dge tshogs zla ba'i zil mngar rgyun// btung ba'i tshogs gnyis lang tsho dar ba'i bus// bden gnyis rtogs pa'i yon tan khab tu bkug /rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bar shog

/don de mngon du gyur min skye ba'i tshal// dal 'byor lus kyi ljon pa bskyed bsring rtser// dge chos snye ma g.yur du za ba yis// sems can re ba 'gengs pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis e waṃ pa'i gtsug lag khang du bla re dang*/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la yol ba phul ba'i mchod bsngo 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ skye ba'i phreng bar rnam bsags legs byas kyi// zong gi dngos po zad mi shes pa yis// mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mgrin pa bkra shis dung*// thog mar brnyes pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dud// de las legs par 'ongs pa bdud rtsi'i dbyangs// gang zhig thob nas nyams su myangs byas na// thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa ster ba'i dung*// dge ba gnyis pa dam pa'i chos la 'dud// bdag rkyen dam pa rgyal ba las byung ba'i// bstan pa dri med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi// 'gro ba ma rig gnyid las slong pa'i dung*// dge ba gsum pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgyal// gangs can 'di na sngon tshe mtha' 'khob kyi// mtshan nyid rdzogs pa gang tshe bshad sgrub kyi// srol bzang 'dzugs pa'i bka' drin che ba'i dung*// dge ba bzhi pa chos rgyal lo paṇa tshogs// so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa'i rgyun// yang dag smra la mgrin pa yangs pa'i dung*// dge ba lnga pa sa skya'i rje btsun dang*// kun dga' bzang po brgyud par bcas btud nas// bsngags 'os kun gyi nang na mtshar che ba// bkra shis mtshan ma ma dmad 'khyil ba las// shis pa'i sgra dbyangs rna ba'i bcud len can// chos dung zung gi che ba mdo tsam brjod// de yang phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med kyi// zhing na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// sku la brgya phrag bsod nams pir dag gis// legs bris bkra shis brgyad kyi ri mo gsal// de dag kun gyi nang nas ches 'phags pa// skyes bu chen po'i mgrin pa'i chos dung ni// smra ba mkhas pa yongs kyis bskal pa brgyar// bsngags par gyur kyang yon tan 'dzad du med// gang de dngos su mthong dang de nyid las// legs byung bdud rtsi thos pa don che yang*// de nyid tshogs lam chen po man chad du// gnas pa skye bos spyod yul las rab 'das// 'on te dman pa'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i gzugs// smon lam dbang gis shar ba gru gzings sogs// dman pa'i gzugs sam rdo shing 'jim pa las// byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis kyang gzhan don 'grub// rgyu mtshan de yis bkra shis rtags kyi gzugs// sna re tsam yang ri'am rtsig ngos la// bris sam 'bur du bton pa tsam gyis kyang*// mi mthun phyogs ngan 'joms pa'i bkra shis byed// 'di ni bcos ma min pas khyad par du// mngon par 'phags pa'i rang byung bkra shis dung*// gang la bzhugs su gsol lam bcang ba na// bde legs 'byung ba'i nor bu nyid du khums// sngon byung bskal par de bzhin gshegs pa yi// sku gdung ring bsrel rgya mtshor nub pa rnams// skye ba lnga pa la sogs nor bu nyid// 'gyur bar gsungs pa'ang sngon gyi smon lam shugs// gang de thob na dpal kun 'byung ba'i gtam// bden pa gcig tu yid la gcags nas sngon// lha dbang lha min g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshe// dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i bkra shis byas// 'jig rten kun gyi bla ma shākya'i sras// 'jig rten khams su mngon par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten 'di na che ba mig stong pas// 'jig rten mchod pa'i thog mar chos dung phul// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ston mchog gis// bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dung*// gnam gyis bskos pa gong ma se chen gyi// bsod nams gser gyi thag pas bzung ste gnas// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i zhabs// lha de'i ral pa'i cod paṇa bcing ba'i tshe// gya nom yon 'bul kun gyi thog ma ru// phul ba'i chos dung da lta sa skyar bzhugs// bod chen ljongs kyi yul gru 'di nyid du// sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag la// brgya phrag mang pos lhag pa'i rten 'brel du// gling gi las dung zhes pa gna' dus kyi// gtam du bsgrags pa dkar po rgyang grags dang*// 'phags pa'i sen rjes can du grags pa dag

/thob pa'i skal ba 'di ni e ma bzang*// gang gi sbubs las 'ongs pa dbyangs snyan gyis// legs par mchod na rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// slob mar bcas pa dgyes bskyed bsod nams kyi// 'bras bu yid 'ong tshangs pa'i dbyangs thob byed// dkar po'i phyogs su dga' ba'i lha rnams ni// kun nas rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur nyin re bzhin// mkha' la lhags nas me tog man+dā raḥ// mi zad char du bsnyil ba'ang 'di yi mthu// gnas skabs kun tu mi dang mi ma yin// 'byung po gdug can bsam sbyor las byung ba'i// nad dang gdon dang rims sogs gnod pa rnams// zhi ba'i bdud rtsis tshim pa yin snyam byed// de la sogs pa'i yid ches gtam gyi rnga// tshad mar gyur pa'i dpang pos brdung ba yis// dgongs pa gyen du drangs pa'i sa la spyod// bla chen kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho yis// skye ba lnga pa'i dung dkar zung dag ni// mdzes byed rgyan dang lhan cig dus gsum gyi// rgyal bar dgyes pa'i rol mor 'bul ba'i slad// gos bzangs gtsang ma'i snyan shal rnam par bklubs// dge ba de yis skye nas skye ba'i phreng*// dkon mchog gsum po rtag tu mchod pa dang*// dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gus len cing*// dge legs snyan pa'i grags pas kun khyab shog /yangs pa'i rgyal khab 'di yis thog drangs pa'i// 'jig rten khams kun bde skyid 'byor pa dang*// chos tshul dge ba bcu la legs spyod cing*// phan tshun byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par shog /ces sde dge bla chen nyid nas lhun grub steng gi chos dung dkar po rgyang grags dang*/ 'phags pa'i sen rjes can gnyis la snyan shal 'bul ba'i dus su bsngags brjod gyis zhes phebs par/ zham ring ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rgyal ba'i zhal bzang ut+pal 'dab// rnam par bzhad pa'i khong gseng las// tshangs dbyangs rkang pa drug ldan gyi// rgyud las 'phos pa'i 'phrin yig glus// nga bstan dri med yongs bzung nas// rmad byung mkhas tshul rnam gsum gyi// lam nas 'dren la bsnyengs bral blo// 'jam dpal gzhon nus byin gyis brlabs// de mthus bdag dang dgongs gcig tu// smra ba mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// lugs bzang 'jig rten khams 'di na// ring por 'tsho ba'i sman pa byas// de mthar 'od mtha' yas pa yi// yon tan bkod pa'i zhing khams der// thogs med yud kyis bgrod pa der// legs gsungs 'dzin par lung bstan pa// gang mtshan kun dga' bzang po zhes// dran dbang yongs kyi sgra 'dzin du// legs bris bdud rtsi'i spun zlar byas// gang de'i zhal skyin byin rlabs kyi// gzi byin nyi ma brgya 'bar ba// gcig tu mthong don snying po ni// dpag yas bskal pa'i tshogs 'dums byed// gang der mdog bzang rin chen khams// thags su bskrun lta'i snyan shal dang*// nyer spyod tshogs dang mar me'i phreng*// phyogs kyi mun pa phrogs snyam byed// gzhan yang bdag lus longs spyod dang*// dge rtsar bcas pa lhun po gling*// sa gzhi rgya mtsho dang bcas pa'i// maṇ+ḍal rnam par sprul pas mchod// gang zhig dad pas gsol btab pa// de la gsang gsum byin rlabs kyis// 'jug pa skyes mchog khyod kyis sngon// thugs rje smon lam shugs yin phyir// de slad mching bu gleng ba la// khyod rjes sgrub pa'i 'dun sems can// kho bor ltos bcas mar gyur gyi// 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi rkang stegs su// rgyal kun 'dus zhal khyod nyid kyi// gsang gsum byin rlabs 'od rdul gyis// reg pa'i mod der ngan 'gro gsum// skye sgo 'gog par byin gyis rlobs// lha las lhag pa'i rten bzang rnyed// khyod rjes mthun par smra rnams kyi// yang 'byung skye bar rjes bzung nas// bslab gzhis bdag rgyud sdom pa dang*// phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung kun la// thos bsam bsgom pa'i blo gros 'phel// blo ldan la 'os las gsum gyis// 'gro blo'i mun sel nyid byin rlobs// mkha' dang mu mnyam sems can rnams// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal khur// dge ba'i stobs 'dis ring bsal nas// bde ba rgyur bcas spyod gyur cig

/ces lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dgar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku brnyan la mchod 'bul snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang 'dod gsol dang bcas pa 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// rigs kyi zhing sar thugs bskyed sa bon btab// rmad byung spyod pa'i sdong po bskyed bsrings rtser// sku gsum snye ma smin pa'i legs gsungs dpal// 'dod 'jo ston mchog thub pa'i dpag bsam dbang*// gang gi zhal skyin srid par lha dang mis// mchod pa mthong don che ba'i yid bzhin nor// gsol btab 'bras bu mchog sbyin thugs rje'i phyag /ris bral 'dod pa'i phyogs su rkyong ba gang*// ston mchog shākya'i tog gyur dngos nyid dang*// rnam dbyer med par bdag lus zhing rdul gyi// grangs snyed sprul pas btud pa'i phyag bgyi'o// me tog spos dang mar me byug pa'i dri// ro drug bda' ba'i zhal zas lha yi gos// che ba'i yon tan thams cad snyan dngags glur// tshe rabs phreng bar 'jo ba'i dam bcas mchod// 'khor ba'i chu nang skye ba'i glang chen khyu// nyon mongs stobs su bdo ba'i tsha gdungs dbal// ma bzod rang bzhin bcas dge'i chu skyes tshal// dkrums pa'i nyes ltung bshags so tshangs par stsol// srid dang zhi bas nyer bsdus lus can gyis// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge bar yi rang gis// gnam 'phyo grong khyer mthong ba'i bsil sbyin mkhan// dga' ba'i 'od dkar gyis bzhin rnam rgyas bgyi// phyogs bcu'i gdul bya ma rig yur ba dag /tshangs dbyangs yan lag rdzogs pa'i glur 'phos pa'i// sad byed brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi tshul// bar med 'doms pa'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' tshul bsngags pa'i mgon po rnams// thugs bzhed 'gegs pa'i spobs pa bdag la med// 'on te thugs bskyed thog ma'i g.yar dam 'phrin// lan brgyar bzla tshe snyan dbang rtsub mi 'tshal// de las byung ba'i dge dang dge ba gzhan// thams cad mthong thos dran pa'i skye bo cog

/gtan bder 'god pa'i thams cad mkhyen thob nas// khams gsum chos kyi snang chen 'gyed phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten thob cing*// khyod gsung smra ba mang pos rjes bzung nas// bcu phrag shes bya rig pa'i blo gros kyis// khyod gsung smra ba'i nyi ma nyid gyur cig /bag yod bslab gzhi 'doms pa'i tshig gis dbul// las nyon sgrib pa 'khrud pa'i mthus dben pa// gaṅgā'i klung brgyas bskal par 'gran min pa// rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// ljongs 'dis nyer mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun// khyod gsum bklags pa'i byin rlabs 'od brgya pas// nad mug mtshon gsum bskal pa'i thun gsum ma// ring bcil bde 'byor 'dab stong rgyas pa'i tshul// skye 'gro'i rkang drug rtsen par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i dri gtsang khang gi thub chen la brgya mchod dang snyan dar phul ba'i zhal byang bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa sarba maṅga la bha wa tu// // ༄༅// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor 'dzad med 'byung ba'i gzhi// dge legs shis pa'i sgo 'phar 'bum phye bas// lhun grub steng zhes grags pa'i gling bu'i dbyangs// phyogs bral skye bo'i rnar snyan 'byin pa der// dbyig 'dzin thig le'i rgyan du tshangs pa yis// ched du sprul pa yin zhes dril chung dag /gtam snyan dbyangs su len snyam gtsug lag khang*// mthong na mngon par dga' ba ga la bar// phyogs bcu'i zhing gi bla ma lhag pa'i lha// rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas// bka' srung nor lha'i tshogs rnams rdul gcig gor// gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul snyed kyis gtams par// grangs med sprul pa'i lus btud phyag gi phreng*// sngon du 'gro bas stong 'khun rgyal po yi// gan gos sna tshogs tshon bkra'i bla re dang*// rgya rol tshangs dbyangs brgya pa'i gtan 'jog bcas// sum ldan dge 'dun 'dus pas ngan song gsum// sbyong byed lhag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor bzhengs// sgrub kyin mchod pa'i sprin tshogs stug pos dkrigs// bdag 'jug dbang gis dag pa'i 'khor lor bsgrubs// bdag cag ltos bcas sa mtshon 'gro ba spyis// skye bar bsags pa'i sdig bshags dge la rangs// chos smra rnams la chos 'khor bskor ba dang*// sems can don phyir rtag tu bzhugs par gsol// bdag gzhan dge ba'i chu klung ji snyed dag

/bla med byang chub chu gter 'dres pa'i mod// yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas mngon bgyid cing*// phyogs bcur sprul pa'i klung brgya 'gyed par shog /grub mtha'i chu klung kun 'bebs brtse ba che'i// bstan pa'i chu gter mnga' bdag e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus tshogs kyis// dbyig 'dzin 'khor lo kun tu brgyan gyur cig /kho bor ltos bcas gson gshin gyis mtshon pa'i// 'gro ba rgya mtshor dkon mchog thugs rje yis// reg pa'i 'phral la sdug bsngal kun 'byung las// rnam grol bde rgyu bcas la spyod gyur cig /ces lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam grub mthong na mngon par dga' bar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod dang*/ stong 'khun mdzod gos kyi bla re dang*/ rgya rol tshangs dbyangs brgya pa'i gtan 'jog bcas phul ba'i tshe/ sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yab gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rgyal gsung rin chen snang ba legs bzung nas// rgyal khams chos smras khyab pa'i dge mtshan byed// rgyal ba'i phrin las skyong ba de la 'dud// gang de'i phrin las 'khor lo sngon 'gro bas// gang du 'khod dgu'i gdul bya dbang sdud cing*// gang 'tsham legs par 'doms pa'i gdan sa che// gang la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling zhes grags// dge bcu'i mtshan ris bkra ba'i yul gru der// dge legs 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi rten// dge mtshan lham mer 'bar bas yongs mdzes shing*// dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang*// legs bris bzo bo bi shwa karma yis// legs byas zhing du bskrun snyam ga la bar// legs 'dod ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis// legs gsungs dri med rjes su slob phyir du// kun mkhyen rgyal bas lung gi bsngags pa'i yul// kun mkhyen gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i sku// kun dga'i dpal ster mtho tshad bdun pa can// kun dga'i lugs bzang ring du rgyas phyir bzhengs// rab 'byams bde gshegs zhing khams bye ba phrag

/phra rab rdul gcig ge na rnam rdzogs par// rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas byin brlabs pas// rab rgyas brtan par bzhugs pa gor ma chag /de yi sku la tshon lnga'i snyan shal dang*// de mdun lhung bzed zhal dkar rdo rje dril// de steng rgyu bzang gos kyi bla re dang*// de bzhin bzo rgyu phun tshogs che legs bcas// gzhan yang dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor steng*// gzhan yid brku ba'i gan gos bla re 'phan// gzhan don bskul ba'i rgya rol dbyangs bdun pa// gzhan yang mchod yul mchod cing bsnyen bkur bstabs// rnam dkar dge ba'i las bzang gang bsags pa// rnam mang skye 'gro legs lam 'khrid mdzad pa// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon bgyid cing*// rnam 'phrul bye bas sems can smin byed shog /yang 'byung skye bas dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan// yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas// yang dag gzigs pa'i bstan la mkhas tshul gsum// yang yang 'doms pa'i rgyal po nyid gyur cig /legs gsungs snang byed sa skya pa yi bstan// legs 'doms kun gyi rgyal po e waṃ pa'i// legs mdzad zla snang dkar pos gar khyab pa// legs gsungs 'chang bas sa stengs khyab par shog /phyogs bral ltos bcas kyis mtshon mkha' mnyam 'gror// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thugs rjes legs khyab pas// phyogs lhung chags sdang sdug bsngal kun bral nas// phyogs ris dben pa'i byams brtse 'byang bar shog /ces sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i lder sku mtho tshad bdun pa gser sbyangs kyis rdzogs par bklubs pa gsar du bzhengs pa la mdun 'jog gi yo byad bcas dang*/ gzhan yang rgya nag gan gos kyi bla res mtshon pa'i bla re rgyu bzang gsum dang rgya rol che legs cha dang tshon lnga'i dar gyis snyan shal bcas rnams gtan 'jog tu bzhag pa'i kha byang bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang*/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// na mash+shākya mu na ye/ legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar 'bum phye bas// khams gsum sems can mngon mtho nges legs kyi// thar pa'i srog 'tsho byed po nyi ma'i gnyen// bstan skyong gnas brtan gyis bskor sku brnyan 'di// gzhar yang ston pa'i bstan dang mi 'bral bar// g.yar dam smon lam lhur len thub dbang gi /gsung skyes ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis// rgyu sbyor bkod pa legs sbyar mngon par bskrun// rnam dkar legs byas dbyar dus mdza' na mos// thub dbang rgyal tshab bcas pa'i lung rtogs kyi// bstan pa'i chu gter ches cher rgyas byed cing*// phrin las chu klung phyogs bcur 'bebs par shog /ces pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba bzhengs pa'i zhal byang du ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// mdo sngags chos kyi nyin byed sa skya pa'i// dad sgrol rnam lnga'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i mthus// kun dga'i legs gsungs thos bsam bsgom byung gi /blo gros rnam gsal 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'dra shog /ces pa'i zhal byang 'di'ang kun dga' blo gsal gyi ngor tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smrig 'chang*// mchog gi rol pas lus can theg gsum lam// smin mdzad dpal ldan chos skyong sku brnyan la// bla ma yi dam srung mas bskor ba 'di// mkhas mchog rnams kyi gsung las skyes pa'i bu// tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes byas tshe rabs phreng*// dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral rten 'brel du// rgyu sbyor bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas bskrun// rnam dkar dge ba'i zla 'od gsar pa yis// sgrib gnyis mun bcom tshogs gnyis kun dga'i tshal// rgya cher bzhad pa'i khong nas chos gzugs sku// zung 'jug snye ma g.yur du za gyur cig

/ces bla ma'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang du ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dho bha wa tu/ dpag yas mkhyen brtse 'dren byed srid zhi yi// khongs las brgal bar spros pas legs bris lam// rang gi mtha' klas grags pa phrogs so zhes// bsting tshig 'brug tu 'byin snyam spyan ras gzigs// gang gi sku brnyan rlung gi rgyal mtshan las// rjes su rkang 'jog gtso 'khor bcas pa yi// ngo mtshar bkod 'di 'phags mchog lhag pa'i lhar// nyer bzung bsgom bzlas lhur len pa des bzhengs// 'dis mtshon dge tshogs skal ldan shing rta yis// thog med skye ba'i sgrib gnyis dri sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug chu gter 'khyil pa'i klong*// sku gnyis nor bu'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /ces spyan ras gzigs kyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa dge'o// // ༄༅// bsil ldan ljongs pa'i lha gcig thugs rje'i gter// bcu gcig zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i gzugs sku la// dngos brgyud bla ma lha yis yongs bskor ba'i// snang brnyan mthong ba don gyi snying po can// tshe rabs phreng bar 'bral med lhag pa'i lhar// gzung bar g.yar dam 'cha' ba'i rnal 'byor pa// shākya'i dge slong lhun grub ting 'dzin gyis// skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing du mngon par bskrun// rnam dkar dge bas rgyu sbyor byed po yis// nyer mtshon mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i rgyud// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'phags pas rjes bzung nas// mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob shog /ces pa'i zhal byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzugs sku 'di// lhun grub ting 'dzin gyis bzhengs dge ba yis// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis yongs sbyangs nas// mthar thug gzhom bral rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/ces tshul rin gyis so// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas zlos pa'i gar// gang zhig dran pas bdud las rgyal ba yi// go 'phang sbyin pa srung ma'i dbang por 'dud// gang gi 'jigs rung nyams kyi 'gyur ba res// chu srin rgyal mtshan sde dang bcas pa yi// don snying kha ru 'byin yang bstan skyong gi /dbu 'phang bstod pa'i gur mgon lcam dral dang*// zhi ba rgyas pa dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub char chen bsnyil ba la// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i srung ma che// zhing skyong gdong bzhi ldan pa sring dang bcas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i khas blangs dang*// dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas pa'i// las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring sprul pa nying sprul bcas// mthu dang dpung gis khengs pa ma btang yang*// rnam 'dren bstan la dga' ba'i ru mtshon dag /'phyar la mi gus med pa srung ma'i tshogs// 'dod pa'i phrin las 'chol la gcig tu dgongs// 'jig rten khams su rgyal bstan rin po che// yun du rgyas phyir rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel rnams// phyi mo gcig las du ma 'byung ba'i 'phrul// chos sbyin mi zad par gyi sgo brgya dbye// de yi bdag rkyen sa spyod kun gyi rtse// bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde// sku 'khor bcas dang bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi// las byed rnams la gegs med gnang ba stsol// mngon par bsgrub bya mtha' ru ma son par// gzugs can gzugs med gtogs pa'i dgra dang bgegs// nad dang rims yams gdon gyi gnod pa sogs// 'gal rkyen bar du gcod dgu zhi bar mdzod// 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*// chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor blo gros sogs// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams phan tshun gcig la gcig /'gran ltar rnam par rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// rigs stobs 'byor pas dregs pa'i che dgu dang*// mi dang mi ma yin pa'i skye 'gro rnams// rigs byed dga' ma'i ut+pal mda' zhu yis// reg pa ji bzhin 'di na rang dbang khugs// bka' yi dgongs 'grel chen po'i 'phrul gyi sgo// rnam par dbye la nag po'i phyogs kyi rigs// phrag dog sems ldan rnams kyis spros pa'i bgegs// zhi ba'i bdud rtsi 'thung bar ma 'dod na// sngon gyi dam tshig la dgongs mthu stobs dang*// mi bzad dpung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed nas ni// 'thor byed dri bzhon dang phrad thal ba bzhin// dgra bgegs dbyings su sbyor dang bsgral bar mdzod// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// lha srung rtag tu bsten pa las byung mthu// grag stong ngag gis gsol btab rten 'brel gyis// bsams pa'i 'bras bu 'phral la smin par shog

/ces pa bka'i dgongs 'grel chen po las rgyud 'grel rnams par du bsgrubs pa'i skabs mgon khang du snyan shal phul te gnang ba mnod cing*/ 'dod pa gsol ba'i ched du tha snyad smra ba tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// //swasti sid+dhi rastu/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'dzum sgros pad+ma las// legs gsungs sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs 'chang gi glus// thub pa'i rgyal tshab cher bstan e waṃ pa// kun bzang grags pa'i 'phrin yig rna bar 'jebs// de gsung sman gyi skyed tshal rgyas pa'i khrod// bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi snye mas dud// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i lo 'dab ches g.yo ba// dpal ldan bla ma yongs 'du'i dbang por 'dud// bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa'i lung rtogs bstan// mkhas tshul gsum gyis bsnyad la zla med cing*// gsang gsum yon tan dpal gyis mngon par 'phags// mkhas btsun bzang po gtan gyi bshes su spyon// mkhas grub yongs kyi bshad sgrub zla snang gis// sa steng dkar por bsgyur ba'i gdan sa gang*// bsam 'grub gling zhes grags par khrims ldan gyi// dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang bzangs su// stong ku'i yul du skyes pa'i 'phrul bzo yis// dus 'khor snying po tshangs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs// rnam bkra mig gi dpyid legs bskrun pa'i// dar 'phan 'dis mtshon sgo gsum longs spyod bcas// sdom pa gsum brgyud bla ma mkhan po'i tshogs// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras slob rkyen gcig rtogs// bka' srung rgya mtshor bcas pa mchod phyir du// dbu mdzad sangs rgyas dpal ldan can gyis phul// 'dis mtshon dus gsum rjes su 'brel pa'i dge /skye 'phags legs byas bcas kun bsdoms pa'i mthus// 'di nas byang chub bar gyi skye nas skyer// bco brgyad chos ldan dal 'byor lus thob shog /gang tshe chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa// de gsung smra mchog e waṃ par bcas pa'i// lugs bzang bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi snod gyur te// rnam 'dren bstan la bya ba byed par shog

/gangs can spyi dang bre brag yul gru 'dir// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bzang spyod rgya mtsho yi// rjes su slob pa'i dge 'dun grangs med dag /'dus pa'i tshogs kyis nor 'dzin mdzes gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sa dkar bsam 'grub gling gi gtsug lag khang du/ dbu mdzad pa sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba kun dngos karma pa'i// bstan pa 'chi med lam gyi rgyan// phrin las sa gsum snang ba po// bstan 'dzin smra ba'i nyi ma mchog /gang gi sku gdung ring bsrel gyi// rin chen rin thang che ba'i dbyig /gcig tu spungs pa'i mchod sdong che// rin chen gnyis pa las grub gang*// su zhig dad pas mchod bgyis na// sdig pa'i sa 'dzin 'jig byed cing*// bsod nams rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i phyir// 'di mthong skal ba mi dman grang*// ci phyir zhe na mchod pa gzhan// spangs nas slob dpon mchod bya zhes// mdo rgyud tshad ma'i me na kas// lung gi gling bu snyan par bsgyur// de tshe dad pa'i sor rtse yis// blo yi sgrom bu phye ba las// ser sna med pa'i stong gzugs kyi// mchod pa'i rnam pa ci yang spros// dngos su 'byor pa'i yo byad kyis// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i bsnyen bkur dang*// zla ba dbang sngon zhun 'dra'i 'phen// sgron ma 'degs pa'i kong bur bcas// dam pa'i drin las skyes pa'i bu// tshul khrims rin chen 'bod de yis// nye bar bskrun pa'i bsod nams kyis// don gnyis grub pa'i gnas thob shog /skye nas skye ba'i gnas skabs su// thams cad mkhyen par 'jug pa'i ngogs// shes bya kun la dbang 'byor nas// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces gnas lnga rig pa smra ba'i dbang phyug karma 'chi med phrin las bstan 'dzin pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten la mchod 'bul bgyid pa'i tshe/

'dod gsol gyi tshigs su bcad pa nyung zad 'di ni slob 'bangs su gyur pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ gar gi drin gyis gnas skabs mthar thug gi /'dod don sgrub mdzad srung ma rgya mtsho yi// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stsol mdzad pa'i// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyis dge legs stsol// zab mo sngags kyi bsnyen sgrub pho nya yis// bskul ba'i mod la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub zad mi shes pa'i dga' ston mkhan// dges mdzad la sogs lhag pa'i lha la 'dud// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs las mngon sprul pa'i// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag /bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces pa'i bu bzhin du// 'bral med skyong ba'i bstan srung rnams la 'dud// gar dgu'i nyams kyi stangs stabs re res kyang*// bdud sde bye ba'i don snying khar 'byin yang*// dam tshig can la lus dang grib ma bzhin// rtag tu 'grogs pa'i gur mgon lcam dral dang*// thugs rje gzhal du med pa'i sprin phung las// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i phrin las kyi// dngos grub ci 'dod char du bsnyil ba la// myur mgyogs gdong bzhi mgon po 'khor bcas dang*// bstan dgra'i snying khrag 'thung la mngon phyogs pa'i// las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring gsum dang ru 'dren bzhi// sprul pa yang sprul nyi zer rdul gyi grangs// gzhan yang mthu stobs bskal pa'i me bo ches// dgra bgegs bar du gcod pa'i mi mthun phyogs// rtswa phung bzhin du thal bar sreg nus pa'i// dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs// khyed rnams rnam pa kun tu mi zad pa'i// yon tan nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang 'byor na// sdig dang 'dres pa'i longs spyod cung zad kyis// mnyes par 'dod pa'i re ba gad mo'i rgyu// 'on te rtse gcig 'dun pa'i yid kyi sgo// 'dzin chags med par yangs por phye ba las// legs blangs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis// dgyes pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba rten 'brel gshis// deng gi dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog

/bla na 'degs pa'i snying stobs rmad po che// sde bzhi dge bcu ldan pa'i sa la spyod// kun dga' 'phrin las rgya mtshor yongs su grags// gang de'i thugs la ji ltar bzhed pa'i don// sgrub pa'i nus pa 'ga' la ma mchis nas// yus pa'i bu chung brtse ba'i ma ma la// 'bod pa'i tshul 'dir re ba rdzogs par mdzod// gang 'di'i rgyud la rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dbyer med lhag pa'i lha yis byin brlabs nas// ring nas dge bas bsgrubs pa'i dal 'byor lus// gtan bde dge ba'i snying pos lci bar mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// mkha' mnyam 'gro la dmigs pa'i byams brtse dang*// byang chub sems kyis bdag rgyud legs sbyangs nas// rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod la 'jug par mdzod// khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa yi// dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs rnams yongs bzung nas// lha sngags ye shes gsum gyi rol pa yis// lung rtogs yon tan rnam par 'phel gyur cig /tshogs gnyis mda' gzhu bskyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// sgrib pa gnyis kyi dgra tshogs bcom nas ni// dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba'i rgyal srid de// gegs med thob pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// byang chub sgrub pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du// phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dang gdon// dus min 'chi dang lo zla zhag dus kyi// keg dang nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar mdzod// rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad dang*// mi dang mi min bsam sbyor rtsub mo las// byung ba'i byad kha rbod gtong gtad khram gyi// gnod pa thams cad bzlog cing med par mdzod// sku tshe bsod nams stobs dang 'byor pa'i tshogs// chab srid 'bangs 'khor legs pa'i yon tan rnams// dkar po'i phyogs kyi zla ba ji bzhin du// gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// gang mtshan gang gis rna bar thos tsam gyis// de dang der gnas lha mi'i 'gro ba rnams// yid srubs yid la nyal ba ji bzhin du// phyogs dang phyogs bral kun nas dbang du sdus// gang gi sku tshe las dbang jus srid la// sdang sems 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams// mthu stobs dpung gi che ba bskyed nas ni// bsad bcad bsgral ba'i phrin las rgya chen mdzod// dkon mchog rnam pa gsum gyi bden pa dang*// lha srung mchod cing bsten pa'i nus mthu dang*// chos kun rten 'byung bden pa mi bslu bas// ji ltar smon pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// ces mgon khang chen por snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol zhig bris shig ces/

sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po nas bka' lung phebs 'phral ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang gi yon tan phyogs re'i ri mo dag /gang dag yid kyi rtsig ngos bris nas ni// gang yang rung ba'i gsol ba btab pa'i don// gang 'dod 'grub pa dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi mthu stobs dang*// rdzu 'phrul ma lus gcig bsdus zlos pa'i gar// dran pa tsam gyis bar chad bdud sde las// rnam par rgyal byed srung ma'i tshogs la 'dud// mi sdug nyams ldan sku yi 'gyur ba res// chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa sder bcas kyi// don snying lkog ma'i lam nas 'dren bzod pa'i// bstan srung dbang po gur mgon lcam dral dang*// thugs rje'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba las// zhi dang rgyas pa dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// phrin las thams cad skad cig gcig sgrub pa'i// zhing skyong gdong bzhi ldan pa sring dang bcas// chos dang chos mdzad gces pa'i bu bzhin du// bskyang bar khas blangs rdo rje'i rwa ba na// gnas pa'i las mgon gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring sprul pa nying sprul bcas// gzhan yang che ba'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dang*// dpung gis khengs pa ldan yang bstan pa la// dga' dang gus pa'i ru mtshon cher bsgreng ba'i// srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bdag la gson// skye dgu'i re ba rdzogs byed khyed cag rnams// yon tan mi zad mdzod la dbang 'byor na// kha na ma tho'i mchod pa cung zad res// mnyes par 'dod pa dbyings nas khrel ba'i rgyu// 'on te ser sna'i rgya yis ma bsdams pa'i// dad pa'i yid sgo phye ba las byung ba'i// mchod pas mnyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dod pa'i don// 'grub pa phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i gshis// deng 'dir bstan pa spyi yi sri zhu pa// sde bzhi dang ldan dge bcu'i 'khor lo yis// 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dbang mdzad bla ma che// kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes pa// gang gi rgyud la bla ma lha mchog gi

sa skyong bla ma chen po ā nan+da karma sa mu dra'i bka' stsal phebs pa'i tshe btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng du bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don// nges par 'grub mdzad bla ma dang*// yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum// mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs bcas rnams// rnam pa kun tu ye shes kyi// gzigs pa la ni sgrib med phyir// bdag gis gsol ba mi 'tshal yang*// re ba'i 'bras bu smon la dgongs// deng 'dir yon gyi bdag po yis// mdzes pa'i snyan shal phul ba dang*// mchod cing bstod pa'i rten 'brel la// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis dngos grub stsol// gnas skabs 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi /bar du gcod pa'i mun pa dag /byin rlabs nus pa'i nyi ma yis// skad cig nyid la bsal du gsol// mthun pa'i phyogs gyur tshe dang dpal// bsod nams blo gros rgyas pa dang*// mthar thug thams cad gzigs pa'i sku// gegs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa rten la snyan shal 'bul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngu 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor// ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs dang phyogs bral zhing na dus gsum du// gshegs dang 'tsho gzhes lus med thul gyi mchog /gang dag bzhugs pa sras dang slob mar bcas// ma lus skye ba'i phreng bar mnyes phyir du// sde snod gsum gyi bshad sgrub dri med kyi// sgra dbyangs rtag par 'jo ba'i dgon sde 'di'i// dri gtsang khang pa mchod 'os rdul gcig gor// rdul snyed kyis gtams mthong ba don ldan 'dir// legs bris yul du bskrun lta'i gos bzangs las// nyer grub mchod pa'i yo byad 'dis mtshon te// dngos dang blo yi bang mdzod phye ba las// legs blangs mchod pa'i chu 'dzin phung pos gtibs// grangs med skye ba'i sdig ltung mngon mthol zhing*// skye 'phags legs byas rgya mtshor yi rang gi

/kun phan zer gyi thigs pas gong nas gong*// spel byas dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len dge 'dun sde// bgrang yas 'dus pas dbyig 'dzin kun mdzes shing*// srid zhi'i dge legs nyi gzhon mthong ba yi// chu skyes tshal bzhin rnam par rgyas gyur cig /ces sde dgon gyi lha khang mthong ba don ldan du mchod rdzas yo byad phul ba'i tshe/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gang dag 'dod pa'i dngos grub ni// kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum// bka' yi srung ma rgya mtshor bcas// khyed rnams kun du thogs med par// ye shes gzigs pa rab gsal phyir// bdag ltas gsol ba ci zhig 'tshal// 'on tang 'di skad smon la dgongs// sbyin bdag dge grogs 'khor bcas kyis// mchod bstod snyan shal phul ba 'dis// mtshon pa'i rten 'brel ji snyed kyis// dgyes pa rab rtser 'dzegs nas ni// ji ltar bsam don 'grub par mdzod// rnam pa thams cad phyi nang gi /bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i// skal ngan mtha' dag thugs rje dang*// mthu stobs rtsal gyis gzhom du gsol// mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal// snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan rnams// dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin bri med par// gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod// ces pa'ang bdag med ma'i spyi pa dge grogs rnams kyis snyan shal phul ba'i tshe/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rab kyi// ral pa'i tshogs rab yongs bzung nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgra dbyangs stong*// bsnyengs bral smra ba'i seng ger 'dud// gang gzugs sgyu 'phrul bkod pa yi// zla ba gzhon nu 'gro yid kyi// chu mtsho dag tu legs shar ba// sku yi snang brnyan ngo mtshar can// 'khor du kun rig dkyil 'khor gyis// dbang bskur brgyud pa'i bla ma yis// yongs su bskor ba'i dus thang ni// mthong na bsod nams rgyas byed 'di// bsnyen sgrub rgyas pa'i dus mchod pa// dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis// thog mar drangs ba'i dge bskos mchod// dbang po'i grangs dang mnyam pas bskrun// sgo gsum 'bad pa'i dga' tshal nas// dge ba'i me tog btus pa gang*// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// dgyes par bskyed pa'i sprin du dkrigs// rgyas par gyur cig 'gro ba'i dpal// dpal gyi 'byung gnas thub dbang bstan// bstan /ces pa lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du dus mchod la dgram rgyur rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge'i dus thang gsar bzhengs kyi bsngo smon 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dge legs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen snod// dge 'dun rgya mtsho dgyes phyir bskrun pa yi// dge bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas phyir dang*// dge 'dun sbyin bdag bcas pa 'phel gyur cig /ces sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar tshogs zangs 'bring po blugs pa'i nang du 'dri byar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras so// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhiḥpra yats+tshan+tu/ dus gsum mi mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i zhal// dbang brgyud gdams ngag 'doms mdzad bla ma dang*// dngos grub mi zad 'byung gnas lhag pa'i lha// gnyis su min pas byang chub bar du skyongs// de yi bka' don phrin las sgrub pa po// ma hā kā la lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon dur khrod yab yum dmag zor sogs// srung ma rgya mtsho gnod sbyin nor bdag bcas// lha srung mchog tu bsten cing mchod bgyid pa// deng gi rnal 'byor sbyin bdag grogs mched dag /mchog gi go 'phang bar gyi mgon skyabs dang*// dpung gnyen kha 'dzin rgyab brten mchog tu mdzod// gzhi byes 'gro 'dug gnas skabs thams cad du// nyes pa kun las bu ltar bsrung ba dang*// legs pa brgya dang rnam pa kun sbyor bas// bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bde ldan ring 'tsho bsod nams rnam par rgyas// longs spyod dbang phyug mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan stobs bdo bas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas thob mdzod// las rlung gis bdas gang du phyin gyur kyang*// de de'i mi dang mi min 'gro ba rnams// sngar 'dris mdza' na lta bu'i 'dzum bsu zhing*// dge chos 'phel ba'i bshes su shar mdzod cig

dbyig 'dzin 'khor lo gang dang gang*// gshegs sam bzhugs pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du// mi mthun phyogs gyur dgra dang chom rkun dang*// gdon bgegs 'byung po bskrad gzir bcing bar mdzod// gang bsam 'dod pa'i 'bras bu lhun grub tu// rtag 'jo dpag bsam ljon pa'i ngang tshul gyis// sems can re ba skong ba'i stong grogs de// bka' srung dbang po khyod kyis rtag tu sgrubs// zhes dur khrod bdag po'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge'o// // ༄༅// swasti/ rab dang yid kyi rin chen rtsig ngos su// dran pa'i tshon gyis rnam par bkra byas pas// srid zhi'i dge legs stsol ba'i bla ma lha// byas gus par phul// 'dis mtshon dge bas byang chub chen po'i bar// srid pa kun du rab 'byams rgyal ba rnams// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnyes bgyid cing*// rgyal sras spyod pas 'gro ba smin byed pa'i dngos grub stsol// 'gro kun dge ba'i chu klung rnams// yi rang rgya mtshor 'dren bgyid cing*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams// chos kyi sgron me sbor bar bskul// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' /yid srubs kyis bsnun 'dod ldan bzhin// dga' ba'i gar bcas rang dbang khugs// zhi las bdud rtsi'i gnas min pa'i// dgra bgegs 'byung po khros pa'i nags// mthu stobs bskal pa'i me bo ches// thal bar rab pa'i// bden mtha' gsal zhing gnod bya gnod byed gnyis// mthar thug bde ba'i go sar phyin par mdzod// ces a gdon nor phyugs dgra jag gis phrogs pa'i chom rkun ngos zin ched du lhun grub steng gi mgon bsngags pa'i lha srin sde brgyad la// mnan gtad gzir ba'i gnod pa bar chad kun// phyir bzlog zhi ba'i bdud rtsi ci yang stsol// ring por 'tsho ba'i srog dang bsod nams dpal// bde legs 'dod dgu'i dga' bzhin du// mnyes gshin dga' ba'i gar bcas rang dbang du// rtse gcig 'dun pa'i phrin las sgrub mdzod cig

/ces mgon khang chen po zung gi snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang*/ gnyer pa bkra shis rgya mtsho'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// cing gus pas mchod pa dang*// stong 'khun dar gyi snyan shal 'di phul mthus// rgyal bstan dri med phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin mchog rnams ring 'tsho'i cho ga sgrubs// sbyin bdag 'khor du bcas pa'i phyi nang gi /rkyen ngan bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med srid zhi dpal 'byor rnams// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang pas mgon khang du snyan shal phul ba'i 'dod gsol du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma dang*// dgyes pa rdo rjes nyer mtshon lhag pa'i lha// gur gyi mgon po gdong bzhi ldan pa sogs// bstan srung rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas su// stong 'khun yul du btags pa'i snyan dar dang*// dngos 'byor yid byung mchod sprin phul ba'i mthus// ji snyed brtsams pa'i las kun thog mtha' bar// kun du gegs bral yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// rtag tu mi dang mi min gdug can gyi// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i chu mtsho rnyog pa ngag /mthu stobs nus pa'i nor bus bgrungs pa la// byams brtse'i zla ba'i gzugs brgya snang bar mdzod// ces sde dge mgon khang rnying par snyan shal phul ba'i zhal yig 'di ni drung yig bstan 'dzin mchog grub don du ban+de tshul rin mdun du bdag cag ltos bcas kyi// grangs med sprul pa'i lus btud phyag 'tshal zhing*// sgo gsum gyis bsags sdig ltung mthol bgyid na// dag byed rgyun gyis bkrus ltar sbyang du gsol// 'gro ba'i dge la dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar spro// ston mchog rnams ni zhi bar mi mnal bar// rtag par bzhugs nas legs par gsungs pa'i char// rgyun du che bar bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// dus 'khor snying po tshangs pa'i yi ge ris// thags su legs bskrun 'phan gyi rnam pas mtshon// dngos bshams yid byung mchod pa'i sprin chen gyis// mchod yul mchod cing dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bgyis// rnam dkar dge bas bu ram shing pa'i bstan// snang byed smra ba'i nyi ma e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len mkhan// 'dus sde'i tshogs kyis sa stengs mdzes gyur cig

/tshul rin zhes bya bdag cag ltos 'khor bcas// gnas skabs skye ba'i phreng bar dal 'byor ldan// rgyal ba'i bstan la thos bsam bsgom brtson zhing*// mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas thob shog /ces pa 'di ni sa dkar bsam 'grub gling gi gtsug lag khang du dar 'phan 'bul ba dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bskrun pa'i tshe bris pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ hūm̐/ tshogs gnyis chu gter che las 'khrungs// rgyal ba kun dngos bkra shis dung*// don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi dbyangs// 'gag pa med khyod rgyal gyur cig /de dang dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas// kun dang thog mtha' bar dge'i chos// bstan pa'i dpal gyur dge 'dun te// mchog gsum yon tan bsams kyin dad// gaṅgā'i rdul snyed sprul pa'i lus// btud pas de dag kun phyag 'tshal// lha rdzas dar gyi 'phan mchog 'dis// mtshon pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// skye nas skye bar bsags pa'i sdig /ji snyed stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags// skye 'phags kun gyi legs byas la// phrag dog spangs pa'i yi rangs bsgom// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i chos rnga che// kun la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// sdug bsngal gyis nyen sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol// de las byung ba'i legs byas kyis// mar gyur mkha' mnyam sems can tshogs// yang dag lam ston bla med kyi// byang chub chen por bdag gyur cig /khyad par dal 'byor rten gyi ma// tshe 'das kun dga' chos skyid can// gang du gnas kyang skyabs gsum gyi// thugs rje'i gzigs pas bran par shog /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po thags su bskrun pa'i dar 'phan yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad dang bcas pa 'di'ang rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung 'gyur gyi yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas/

sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs phrin las gter// gcig tu bsdus pa rab 'jigs keng rus gzugs// dran pa tsam nas bsam don kun sgrub pa'i// nor sbyin dur khrod bdag po yab yum la// skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma bde ba'i mchog /tshe dpag med mgon rta mgrin dbang gi lha// thugs rje myur ma dpa' mo 'od zer can// rnam thos bu dang re man+ta la sogs// mi nor rta phyugs kun gyi g.yang spel ba'i// phan 'dogs shis pa sgrub pa'i lhas bskor ba'i// sku brnyan 'di bris bsod nams stobs dag dang*// rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sbyin pa'i bdag po mi phyugs bzhon par bcas// gzhi byes kun du srung skyob mi g.yel bar// nyes brgya bskal pa'i pha rol spyugs pa dang*// legs brgya lhan cig 'dzom pa'i phrin las sgrubs// bde srog 'phrog pa'i sdang dgra chom rkun dang*// gcan gzan gdug pa'i nyer 'tshe mi 'byung bar// rtag tu bsrung zhing 'byung du srid na yang*// bcing dang bskrad gzir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// mi nad phyugs nad gdon bgegs phyi nang gi /'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i gnod pa gang byung yang*// mthu ldan khyed cag dran pa'i mod nyid la// mun dang snang pa phrad ltar zhi bar mdzod// bsod nams ri bo rab brling ngos yangs su// dpal 'byor dbyar skyes phreng ba tshar du dngar// tshe yi chu klung chad med 'jo ba la// spyod pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dngos grub stsol// zhes dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bris sku la 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni gnyer pa bkra shis rgya mtsho'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha watu// // ༄༅// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i bstan srung tshogs// yid rab dwang bas mchod rdzas 'di phul bas// yid la bsams pa'i dngos grub ci dang cis// yid kyi shing rta phyur bur gtams par mdzod// ces pa 'di smyug thogs bstan 'dzin mchog grub kyi ngor tshul rin gyis so//

// ༄༅// dus gsum bde gshegs phrin las mtshar sdug gzugs// mngon par sprul nas yid can srid mtsho las// gdon pa'i dam bca' g.yel med lhur len cing*// dran pas gdung ba sel brtson sgrol ma la// lha reg gis mtshon dang ba'i yid sgo nas// mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar bstod byas pas// bstan 'dzin mchog grub ces bya rnam pa kun// 'jigs brgyad bar chad kun dang bral bar mdzod// ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams 'dzad med dpal// lung rtogs yon tan bla nas blar 'phel sogs// yid la bsam kun gegs med legs 'grub cing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor par mdzad du gsol// ces 'di'ang smyug thogs bstan 'dzin mchog grub kyis sgrol mar snyan shal phul ba'i 'dod gsol du tshul rin gyis bris so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ 'phags pa phyag na pad+ma sems can gyi// dbul phongs sdug bsngal bsal phyir nor bdag gi /sgyu 'phrul gyis rtsen ci 'dod dbyig gi dpal// mi zad 'bebs pa 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin dkar// gang la bla ma yi dam nor sbyin lhas// kun nas bskor ba'i bris sku dbang po'i tshon// na tshod dang por gnas pa'i gzugs kyi zla// gus sbyor gtong ba phun sum tshogs pas bskrun// bde gshegs rin chen mang dang mkha' mdzod sogs// 'gro ba'i re skong rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// gter bdag gnod sbyin lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// rten 'dir mi 'bral rtag tu brtan par bzhugs// de mthus sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bsod nams tshe// mi rgyud nor phyugs mnga' thang dpal 'byor rnams// lhun po bskal pa'i srid dang lam gsum 'bab// dbyar dus rin chen 'byung gnas rjes 'gror shog /yang srid kun du chos dang srid pa'i dpal// 'dzad med gter la dbang 'byor ma chags pa'i// gtong phod lag pa'i yal ga ring brkyangs nas// 'jig rten re ba skong ba'i mchog gyur cig

/ces pa'i 'dod gsol 'di'ang dzam+bha la bris sku'i rgyab ngos su 'dri rgyur bstan pa lhun grub kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa dge'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhiḥpra yats+tshan+tu/ dus gsum mi mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i zhal// dbang rgyud gdams ngag 'doms mdzad bla ma dang*// dngos grub mi zad 'byung gnas lhag pa'i lha// gnyis su min pas byang chub bar du skyongs// de yi bka' don phrin las sgrub pa po// ma hā kā la lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon dur khrod yab yum dmag zor sogs// srung ma rgya mtsho gnod sbyin nor bdag bcas// lha srung mchog tu bsten cing mchod bgyid pa// deng gi rnal 'byor sbyin bdag grogs mched dag /mchog gi go 'phang bar gyi mgon skyabs dang*// dpung gnyen kha 'dzin rgyab brten mchog tu mdzod// gzhi byes 'gro 'dug gnas skabs thams cad du// nyes pa kun las bu ltar bsrung ba dang*// legs pa brgya dang rnam pa kun sbyor bas// bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bde ldan ring 'tsho bsod nams rnam par rgyas// longs spyod dbang phyug mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan stobs bdo bas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas thob mdzod// las rlung gis bdas gang du phyin gyur nas// de de'i mi dang mi min 'gro ba rnams// sngar 'dris mdza' na lta bu'i 'dzum bsu zhing*// dge chos 'phel ba'i bshes su shar mdzod cig /skyabs mchog gsum gyi thugs rje byin rlabs dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal che ba'i gtam// bden pa gang gis yid la gcags pa'i don// ma lus myur du 'grub par bkra shis stsol// zhes lhun grub steng gi mgon khang chen por snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol bsam don lhun grub ces pa 'di ni/ gnyer bkra shis rgya mtsho'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob ji snyed kyi// gsang gsum yon tan bskal pa snyigs ma 'dir// rnam 'dren mchog gi lung rtogs bstan pa zung*// phyogs kyi bzhin ras snang byed kun dga' bzang*// gang gi lugs bzang rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i gdugs// lhar bcas skye dgu'i srid pa'i gdung sel mkhan// bla na 'tsho zhing gzhes slad bshad sgrub dbyangs// 'og min mthar thug lud pa'i gtsug lag khang*// gang der bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum gyi// bka' srol brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang thos sgrogs phreng*// bstan srung rab 'byams dges pa'i mchod sprin du// dbang phyogs ma hā tsi na'i 'phrul bzo yis// thags su nyer bskrun rdo rje srong lam gyi// bla re mchog dang gos bzang 'phan tshar cha// bde chen snying po len pa'i yol sgor bcas// sde bzhi'i dpal ldan dge bcu'i bka' khrims kyis// yangs pa'i nor ldan skyong gi rgyal khab kyi// nye 'dabs gyi nar gnas pa'i ldom bu ba// dge slong tshul khrims dpal bzang can gyis phul// bslu med skyabs kyi gtso bo dkon mchog gsum// sgo gsum gus pas mchod kyis bsnyen bkur ba'i// dge bas rang nyid ltos bcas rgya mtsho'i rgyud// tshogs zung pha rol phyin pa'i sa thob shog /de srid skye bar dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten// chos mig rab yangs dam pa'i phreng bas bzung*// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs mchog bskal pa'i bar// brtan byed bshad sgrub dri med lhur len shog /lung rigs smra ba bye bas bsngags brjod kyi// snyan dngags u dum+bā ras 'thor ba'i gnas// e waṃ yi ges mtshan bstan nyin mor byed// skye dgu'i legs byas dgung dbus brtan gyur cig /ces e waṃ gtsug lag khang du gos yol bla re 'phan cha bcas phul ba'i bsngo byang 'di ni/

chos rje tshul khrims dpal bzang pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyis legs gsungs lha yi rnga// brjod byed dag pa'i rang sgra stong ldir bas// rnam 'dren bzhi pa rang gi lung rtogs bstan// snang byed sgron mar lung bstan kun dga' bzang*// de tshul dri med 'dzin pa'i ngur smrig 'chang*// grangs med 'dus pa dbyig 'dzin khur chen pos// klog dang spong ba'i 'khor los rtsen pa'i gnas// gling par grags pa'i gtsang khang ga la bar// mdo sngags bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum gyi// bka' srol rmad byung dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras slob kun dang chos skyong ba'i// mchod 'os rgya mtsho ma lus mchod bya'i phyir// stong 'khun yul grur btags pa'i gos 'phan 'di// sde dger zhes grags sa yi tshangs pa des// legs par bsrungs pa'i nor 'dzin thig le nas// dge slong tshul khrims dpal bzang bod pas phul// legs byas 'dis mtshon sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs// rang nyid ltos bcas thog drangs mkha' mnyam gyi// lus can tshogs gnyis gom pa cher bkod pas// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i grong khyer son gyur cig /lung rigs tshad mas mngon mtho e waṃ pa'i// tshul chen thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos// 'khor ba yongs su ma grol de srid du// nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar gsal gyur cig /ces e waṃ gling pa'i gtsug lag khang du gos 'phan la 'dri bya chos rje tshul khrims dpal bzang po'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen kun ye shes khams// srid par sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i lus rdzogs pa// mkhas tshul gsum gyi lang tsho'i dga' ston gyis// yid can thar pa'i srog 'tsho sa skya pa// de tshul 'jig rten snang byed grangs med dbus// thabs shes yi ges mtshan pa'i do zla su// mkha' dbyings mi ltung phreng ba rnam mang khrod// bdud rtsi'i 'od can gnyis pa cang mchis sam// de dag brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' lung dang*// dam tshig rdo rje'i mdud pa snying bkod pa// rnam kun g.yel med sgrub pa srung ma'i gtso// ston pa'i gsang gsum sprul pa nag po che// gsang rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying po dges rdor gyi// bdud rtsi'i bshad sgrub dri med skyong byed pa// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa yang yon tan gyi// gom gcig bgrod pas gnon pa'i mthu rdzogs kyang*// rgyal bstan bsrung phyir bram ze'i tshul bzung ba// gnyen mgon chen po srid bzhi 'jigs mar bcas// mi sdug nyams kyi rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis// bstan dgra'i lha min lus phra'i mngal gyi khur// skad cig gnyis par mi gnas dus 'dzin khar// nye bar stob byed rdzu 'phrul mthu bo che// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming sring gsum// pho nya ru 'dren sde bzhi dur khrod bdag

/dmag zor re wa tī sogs dus rtag par// bsten cing sgrub pa'i lha srung 'khor bcas rnams// gsang gsum yon tan phrin las che ba'i gtam// zegs ma lung gi 'phrin du shod pas kyang*// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor 'dzad bral nam mkha'i mdzod// rang dbang brnyes pa'i dbang phyug khyed cag la// 'di na phal pa'i rdzas las nyer bskrun pa'i// 'di de'i mthun pa'i rdzas kyis phongs min yang*// sngar bcol phrin las bsgrubs pa'i gtang rag dang*// da jus g.yel med bsgrub pa'i dran bskul du// zhi drag chas kyi bgo ba sna tshogs dang*// snyan brjid sgra dbyangs rol mo'i bye brag dang*// ye shes lnga mtshon lag cha mtshon cha'i rigs// lha mi'i yul gyi nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga// spyan gzigs bzhon pa'i khyad par rnam mang rnams// brnab sems bdag 'dzin zhags pas ma bcings pa'i// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi sgo 'phar 'bum// cig car phye ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'di// rnal 'byor dam tshig rjes su dgongs bzhes nas// bka' srung byang chub bar du mnyam 'grogs shing*// gzhung lugs thos dang bsam pa yang dag lam// sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod// gang tshe ring 'tsho'i klung brgya 'bebs mkhas pa'i// bsod nams ri bo rab brling ngos yangs por// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i phreng*// bstan 'gror sman pa'i gsos su rgyas par mdzod// snying rje dar bab yid 'phrog zur mig gis// phyogs bral dbyig 'dzin la 'khod rigs 'byor gyis// khengs ldan skye bo'i brtan pa rang dbang du// 'gugs byed dbang sdud phrin las grub par mdzod// bstan srid rnam par sdang ba'i yid can ri// drag sbyor gnam lcags sgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis// lus rten bems po phra rab rdul bshig nas// rnam shes skye med legs bris lam du sbyor// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kyi sos ka'i then// mthu stobs 'chi med char gyis nyer bcil nas// bstan srid 'dod pa'i myu gu bskyed bsrings rtser// don gnyis grub pa'i snye ma g.yur za mdzod// 'dir mchod rdzas gsar bskrun phul ba'i rnam grangs ni/

gser srang gsum las grub pa'i yid bzhin nor bu'i gzugs brnyan/ dngul srang nyi shu las grub pa'i nor bu 'bar ba/ zangs gser las grub pa'i bkra shis rtags kyi 'khor lo/ rin po che 'bar ba/ bkra shis pad+ma lo 'dab rgyas pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ gos chen gser gyus ma'i bla bre/ gos sna tshogs kyi 'phan/ lda ldi/ gri lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga/ rdo rje gri gug gaṇ+ḍi/ gaṇa g.yog ral gri/ rtse gsum/ mdung thung*/ spu gri/ gseg shing sdigs pa'i yu ba can/ chu gri/ 'phang mdung*/ thags mdung*/ mdung ring*/ wa mda' gzhur bcas/ mda' bo che gzhur bcas/ phur bu/ dam shing*/ dgra s+t+wa/ gtun shing*/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ s+t+wa re/ pi wang*/ me long*/ rnga yab dngul gyi yu ba dngul zho drug cu re lnga las bzos pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rdo rje/ tho ba/ lcags sgrog zhags pa/ mu tig rdog po chung ngu bdun/ byi ru rgya mo lag pa chung ngu rdog po/ mu men rdog po/ sbur len shel rdog po/ gzi rings/ ma ne ho rdog po/ dung rdog po/ shel rdog po gsum/ g.yu rdog po che ba/ rdo rje dril bu rtse dgu rgya dpe can cha/ rgya sbub shin tu che bzang cha/ rag dung dngul gyi sba dkris can cha/ 'dogs rnga gcig 'khar rnga gcig sku srung mda' gzhur bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon da ro ha gser tshags can/ khrab zhubs tshang*/ ral gri ltag gyed ma/ me mda' dzām grag a skyabs dges thi ma/ bse ru cha/ ba so cha/ ma he'i rwa ya/ wa lpags/ g.yi lpags/ o rod su'i sram spags/ bod kyi sram lpags/ gung lpags/ stag gung lpags/ sbre lpags/ spyang ki dkar nag gi pags pa/ gsa' lpags/ 'phar lpags/ dom lpags/ gzig lpags/ stag lpags rnams so// smras pa/ rgyal bstan lha gnas phrag par 'degs bzod pa'i// sa skyong bla ma'i gsang gsum lhun po'i spo// bskal pa brgyar brling phrin las nyi zla'i 'od// bstan srid 'dab stong gnyen du gsal gyur cig /ces nub mgon khang du rgyal ba'i bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgyes par bskyed pa'i bskang rdzas mchod pa'i yo byad 'di dag sngar bcol legs par bsgrubs pa'i gtang rag dang*/

da jus g.yel med bsgrub pa'i dran bskul du/ sa skyong bla ma chen po lcam dral nas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed du bod pa'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dbo zla'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes dge bar stob pa'i skabs su 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga la bha wa tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las bdag /dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yi dam lha// dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang stobs bcu pa'i// bstan pa skyong zhing phyogs mthar rgyas byed pa// nag po chen po gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong pa bzhi ldan dpal mgon yum chen bzhi// las byed mgon po dregs pa pho mo'i rgyud// dur khrod bdag dang dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// mkhyen brtse nus pa rdzu 'phrul dpag yas sgo// 'dod dgu 'byed pa'i bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dam tshig rta mchog thegs pas tshur spyon la// bdag la brtser dgongs 'dod pa'i phrin las sgrubs// bstan 'gror phan pa'i sems kyi byed po yis// nyer bskrun 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mkhas tshul gyi// phrin las skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun chen bzhin// bskal pa'i yun bsrings ches cher rgyas par mdzod// gang phyir deng nas mngon par brtsam dgu kun// bar chad gegs med thog mtha' bar dge ba'i// bsam don snye ma legs smin dus ston bzang*// bstan 'gro la phan ring 'tsho mchog tu sgrubs// kho bo ltos bcas nye zhos rnam dben par// tshe ring nad med bde ldan srid zhi'i dpal// phun tshogs tshe dpag med mgon yon tan gyi// bkod pa 'di na 'phos snyam nyid du mdzod// rnam dkar dge bas brtse chen e waṃ pa// mchog zung bstan pa'i dbyar skyes cher rgyas khrod// grangs med smra mkhas ko ki la yi phreng*// bshad sgrub glu len rtag par 'phel gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni 'dzin byed lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer dgu la mgon khang chen por rang gi 'dod don 'grub phyir bskang gso snyan shal 'bul ba'i zhal byang du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ skyabs gnas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang ba sogs// dbang bskur gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs dkon mchog rnam pa gsum// bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon gnyen po sring bzhi bcas// las mgon dregs byed pho mo dur khrod bdag /dmag zor re ba ti sogs bka' srung dang*// gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs bcas bdag la dgongs// deng gi sbyin bdag dge grogs 'khor bcas kyis// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur dang*// bstan 'gror spyi yi las kyi 'gan 'degs phyir// brtsam dgu mtha' ru son pa de srid du// mi dang nor phyugs bde ba'i dpal 'thung la// phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs keg dang srir ldang ba'i// nad gdon dgra bgegs dus min 'chi ba sogs// bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod// 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med bsod nams stobs// dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan par grags pa'i dbyangs// kun nas rgyas pa dpal ldan ngal bsos bu'i// dbang thang 'di na 'phos snyam nyid du mdzod// gzhi byes gnas skabs kun du thugs rje'i spyan// 'dzums pa med pa'i rwa bar legs bcug nas// bde legs shis pa'i phyogs spel nyes las srung*// bsam kun 'grub pa'i srung bskyab mdzad du gsol// ces pa bdag med ma'i spyi pa dge grogs rnams kyis gang brtsams gegs med 'grub pa'i 'dod gsol 'di ni/ bskul ba po'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa smras don 'grub par gyur cig/ //maṅga la// // ༄༅// phyogs bral bde gshegs yongs kyi sgyu 'phrul gar// 'gro tshogs 'jigs las sgrol ba'i yon tan gter// sde snod gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston mkhan// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// zhi 'dzum khro chags nyams ldan rnam rol gyis// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub ci dang ci'i// skyes bzang 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i shing rta che// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs ji snyed dang*// kun phan dkyil 'khor las byung 'chi byed dang*// lho phyogs dri bzhon gyis drangs tsha gdung bzhin// gang la skyabs song mthong chos byang chub bar// bslus pa'i 'phrin yig srid min dkon mchog gsum// bar chad bgegs dgra'i tshang tshing 'khrigs gyur kyang*// rdzu 'phrul mthu yi zhugs lces reg tsam gyis// skad cig gnyis par mi gnas rdul phran du// sreg byed bstan srung chen po rdo rje gur// gdong bzhi ldan pa yum bzhi dregs pa'i sde// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming lcam gsum// dur khrod zhing skyong dmag zor rgyal mos mtshon// bka' srung nor sbyin lha tshogs da tshur gson// deng 'dir sbyin bdag dge grogs 'khor bcas rnams// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur sogs// spyi las chen po'i 'gan 'degs rtsom pa kun// legs par pha rol phyin gyur de srid du// 'byung tshogs lus srog rnam 'tshe'i nad dang gdon// dgra bgegs dus min 'chi dang srir ldang ba// 'gal rkyen zung rngu gang lags skad cig gcig

/zhi byed las kyi zil dngar ci yang stsol// srid gsum sgrun du med pa'i mkhyen brtse dang*// mthu rtsal thogs pa med pa ku li sha'i// srung ba'i ra gur yangs pa ga la bar// mi dang nor phyugs 'khor bcas ring 'tsho'i tshe// bsod nams longs spyod 'byor pa rnam dkar las// grags pa'i dbyangs rnams skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun// lhun po 'khor los sgyur dpal dag byed gter// zla ris dkar po'i rjes 'gror rgyas par mdzod// dgos pa gang phyir gzhir gnas byes su bzhud// gnas skabs kun du nyes phyogs yongs las srungs// gang bsams legs dgu'i dpal dang nyer phrad cing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// lha srung gnyen po mchod pa'i nus mthu dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam smon lam stobs dag gis// zhi dang bsrung rgyas mngon spyod phrin las rnams// gang 'tsham gegs bral 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mchod yul rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bskul ba'i 'dod gsol tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang lhun grub steng spyi chen pa bkra shis 'byung gnas dge grogs rnams kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phrang du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// bsam 'phel nor 'dra bla ma dkon mchog gsum// bsam don dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bsam kun rdzogs byed bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bsam bya'i snye ma gsol la brtse bas dgongs// rnam dkar byed po'i lhag bsam rmad byung gis// rnam mang mchod yul rgya mtsho dgyes phyir du// rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar nas// rnam rig brnags don mkhyen bzhin 'grub par mdzod// gang bcol sgrub la dbang 'byor khyed rnams kyis// gang bsams la gor grub pa'i yid ches gtam// gang 'dod snying la sim pa'i dga' ston la// gang dgar spyod pa'i skal ba mchog la sbyor// ces pa mgon khang du snyan shal 'dod gsol 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// na maḥ.a mo gha sid+dhā ya/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab snying po gsang chen gyi// dbang bskur gdams ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dkon mchog gsum// rgyal bstan skyong bar khas 'ches dam tshig can// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran// gdong bzhi dpal mgon sring bzhi dregs pa'i sde// gnod sbyin yab yum pra tra ming sring tshogs// dur khrod dmag zor beg tse lcam sring bcas// 'di na tshur gson deng dus sbyin bdag gis// bsags pa'i dngos rdzas longs spyod stobs chen dag /ma byin 'phrog bcom mi dge'i las ngan mkhan// deng du ming yul gang bzhin 'khor sder bcas// deng 'dir rgyal khrims rwa bar nyer bkug nas// bzang ngan las kyi 'bras bu ma 'jol bar// nag nyes gang byas las 'bras bden stobs kyis// nyes byas mngon sum mthong ba'i phrin las sgrubs// mthong don sbyin bdag bsam don kun 'grub cing*// de mthar gnod bya gnod byed ltos dang bcas// nad med ring 'tsho'i bde dga' 'byor pa'i dpal// chos mthun dge bar sbyor ba'i stong grogs mdzod// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden nus 'dzam bu yi// snye ma lhag bsam chu gter lhung ba'i 'phral// ci 'dod snying po'i gser du mngon gyur nas// rang gzhan re ba rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang don gnyer zhig gis bsam don nye char 'grub pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa'i snyan shal kha byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyud sde bzhis bstan yi dam rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras slob ma bstan srung nor sbyin bcas// phyag bgyir 'os pa kun la thal sbyar btud// de dag rnams kyi gzugs dang gzugs brnyan dag

/rten dang brten pa'i rnam par legs shar ba// bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dga'i gan+dho la// rgyal kun zhing gi yon tan 'di la rdzogs// de nang stong 'khun rgyal po'i gan mdzod las// 'phos pa'i gos bzang bla re zung dag gis// nyer mtshon dngos bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i// kun bzang mchod pa'i phreng ba tshar du dngar// mtha' med 'khor bar skye ba'i lu gu rgyud// sems rgyud rang bzhin gtsang ma'i me long du// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung dri ma yis// yon tan ltad mo 'gog byas mthol zhing bshags// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das 'gro tshogs kyis// bsags pa'i legs byas ut+pal dkar po'i tshal// yi rangs zla ba'i bsil zer 'bum 'phro bas// bsod nams 'dab ma yangs par bskyed bgyi'o// mi shes mun par 'thums pa'i lus can ngor// mu med phyogs kyi chos smra thams cad la// mos pa'i blor 'tshams legs gsungs snang ba yis// legs pa'i lam mchog rtag tu 'doms par bskul// mtshan bzang gzugs sku myang 'das dbyings brtul ba'i// spros bral mngon du bgyid la gzhol ba rnams// sdug bsngal kun 'byung gis gtses sems can rnams// yongs su grol min de srid 'tsho gzhes bzhugs// dge bas sbyin bdag ltos bcas rnams kyis mtshon// skye 'gro rgya mtshos tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas// khams gsum chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed mkhas pa'i// rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po mngon gyur cig /mchod pa'i yo byad 'di dag dge 'dun gyi// gtsug lag khang chen 'di dang mi 'bral bar// gdong bzhi dpal mgon khyod la gnyer gtad kyi// ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan zur gtod cig kye// zhes lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du bla re gnyis rol mo rag dung cha dge 'dun gyi bzhugs 'bol bcas bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pa sku mched rnams kyis phul ba'i tshe yan lag bdun pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren dbang po sras bcas kyi// yon tan bkod pa'i zhing khams dpag yas kyang*// rten dang brten pa'i rdul phran re re'i gor// legs par snang ba'i gtsug lag khang chen 'dir// tsi na'i yul gyi 'phrul bzos thags su btags// gnam bskos bang mdzod las blangs gos bzang gi /bla re 'phan dang rol mo rag dung cha// 'dus tshogs bzhugs pa'i 'bol gdan bcas pa 'di// thub dbang thub pa'i rgyal tshab e waṃ pa// brgyud bcas legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i 'tsho ba pa// sdom brtson kun dga' rgya mtsho sku mched kyis// byang chub spyod pa'i chu gter dgang phyir phul// de las skyes sogs dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin skyes bus nor 'dzin yongs khyab cing*// de dag phrin las phyogs su rgyas phyir bsngo// kuṃn dgaṃ'i 'byung gnas bshad sgrub rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i dpyid// re ltos bcas pas nyer mtshon mar gyur 'gro// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho legs brgal lung rtogs kyi// yon tan rin chen gling la dbang 'byor shog /phul ba'i mchod rdzas 'di rnams rnam pa kun// gtsug lag khang 'di'i phyi rol mi 'da' bar// gnyer gtams gdong bzhi dpal mgon khyod nyid la// nges par bcol lo gzigs shig bstan srung kye// zhes bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pa sku mched rnams kyis lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du bla re zung dang gos 'phan rol mo rag dung*/ dge 'dun gyi bzhugs 'bol rnams 'bul ba'i kha byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti bha wa tu/ smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs zab don khrid// rgyab brten lung gi bka' srol dngos brgyud kyi// dpal ldan bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs// byang chub bar gyi skyabs su thal sbyar btud// mu med phyogs bcu'i zhing gi bde gshegs kyi// yon tan bkod pa rmad byung smon lam mthus// rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor legs shar ba// bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dga'i gtsug lag khang*// bsod nams gnam gyis bskos pa mi bdag gi

/rin chen gan mdzod las 'phos gos 'phan chas// nyer mtshon mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar nas// mchod yul rgya mtshos bskal pa ji srid mchod// rang sems gnyis 'thung nyon mongs sos then gyis// cher gdungs srid pa'i rdzing bu gom pa bkod// dge legs chu yi rgyal mtshan nyams byas pa// mthol tshangs dran shes lcags kyus dbang du bgyid// kun phan gzhon nu mthong ba tshangs pa'i bu// sngon med rab dga' khong nas rgyas pa bzhin// srid pa mya ngan las 'das legs byas kyi// rjes su dga' ba'i 'dzum zer dkar pos bstsu// snyigs ma'i sems can gdul dkas skyo ba'i gsung*// mi smra btang snyoms nyid du mi bzhugs par// gang 'tsham bla na med pa'i legs gsungs kyi// dbyangs snyan rgyun chad med par 'byin par bskul// mtshan bzang lham mer snang ba gzugs kyi sku// chos dbyings zab mor brtul na gya nom gyi// yon tan dpag yas rnyed par gyur kyang bla// mgon med sems can skyabs su rtag bzhugs gsol// 'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i zla 'od ni// gzhan don byang chub chu gter 'phel ba'i rgyur// yongs bsngo yon tan mi zad rin chen gter// lus can nyer 'tsho chen por mngon gyur cig /bskal pa'i srid dang khyab 'jug zhabs bsil rgyun// na kra'i grong khyer ji bzhin rgyu sbyor gyis// nyer mtshon sems can khams kyi ring 'tsho dang*// bsod nams dpal 'byor gter la spyod par shog /ces gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nang du mkhar nang bla ma chen pos gos 'phan mchod 'bul dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bgyis pa'i tshe/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba dang smon lam gsol ched ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// phyogs bcur nam mkha'i mtha' klas legs bzhugs pa'i// rdzogs sangaṃs rgyaṃs dang lung rtogs dam pa'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'dus pa'i bdag

/skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal// gang thugs skye 'jig gzebs las rnam grol ba// rnam kun mchog gi bde chen mngon bgyis pa'i// sku gdung byin rlabs chos sku'i ring bsrel gyis// mngon par gtams pa'i byang chub mchod rten cher// nyer spyod phreng bas mdun bdar gos bzang bklubs// bdag sogs lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs bcas// sa gzhi ri gling rgya mtsho lha mi'i dpal// ma tshang med par sprul pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul// skye bar bsags pa'i sdig bshags dge bar dga'// smra mchog chos sgra 'byin zhing bzhugs par gsol// dge ba sems can srid pa'i chu gter las// yongs sgrol thub pa'i ded dpon che phyir bsngo// mchog gi go 'phang phyin pa de srid du// kunaṃ mkhyen rab dgaṃ' bskyed pa'i phrin las kyis// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos can la 'khod lus can khams// mdo sngags chos kyi snang chen 'gyed par shog /ces 'dren mchog bla ma sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sku gdung gi mchod rten chen por snyan shal dang mchod 'bul gyi tshe zhal byang du bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pa'i gsung mchid phebs 'phral ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// sarba ar+tha sid+dhi rastu/ bde legs dpal gyi sgo 'byed bla ma dang*// ci 'dod dngos grub sbyin mdzad yi dam lha// skyabs song mi bslu nges pa dkon mchog gsum// las bzhi lhun grub bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// khyad par rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi /'dren pa mchog gi bar byon bka' lung dang*// dam tshig dbang gis 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing*// bsam don thogs med sgrub pa'i phrin las can// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi ldan pa sring bzhi dregs pa'i sde// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// dur khrod bdag po dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// bsten cing 'go ba'i lha srung thams cad la// skyabs su bstan cing dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi// dgyes bskyed mchod sprin rgya mtshos mdun bdar nas// ding 'dir bsam don phrin las zhu'o kye// rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa dri ma med// 'jig rten snang byed chen po sa skya pa'i// lugs mchog bshad dang sgrub pa'i bgyi ba yis// bskal pa ji srid rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// de tshul 'doms pa'i rgyal po grangs med dbus// rgyu skar khrod kyi zla gzhon ltar gsal ba// kun dga' bzang bstan bshad sgrub lhur len pa'i// bla gos tshon gyis phyogs kun bklubs snyam mdzod// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub ring 'tsho'i cho ga mkhan// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bskal par zhabs brtan zhing*// bstan jus phrin las phyogs kun rab rgyas par// bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs// bdag cag 'khor bcas sgo gsum bde ba'i bcud// 'thung la bar du gcod pa'i nad rigs dang*// 'byung ba gdon tshogs 'khrugs pa'i gnod pa kun// snang bas mun ltar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// phrag dog sdang sems ldan pa'i byad ma yis// bsam sbyor rtsub mos byad gtad mnan pa dang*// mi dang mi min gnod pas mi tshugs par// rtag tu bsrung zhing phyir bzlog phrin las mdzod// rang gzhan don chen sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor gyis// bgyi ba gang brtsams thog mtha' bar kun tu// bgegs dang nyer 'tshes dben par bzhed dgu kun// dge ba sum ldan nyid du mthar phyin mdzod// bsod nams lhun po ltar brling tshe yi rgyun// gaṅgā'i klung bzhin bskal pa'i yun bsring zhing*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor chu gter che ltar 'khyil// phrin las nyi zla'i 'od 'drar rgyas par spel// 'dod lhas sprul pa'i mtshar sdug lang tsho yis// 'dod ldan gzhon nu'i yid bzhin stobs 'byor dang*// yon tan che dgu thams cad rang dbang du// 'bad med 'dun pa'i yid 'phrog phrin las mdzod// bsam don mtha' dag sgrub la gegs byed pa'i// dgra bgegs gdug pa'i bsam sbyor tsher ma'i nags// tshar gcod phrin las bskal ba'i me bo ches// skad cig nyid la gzhob tu thul bsregs nas// rnam shes skye med dbyings su bstim mdzod cig

/mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rang gzhan don du rgyal ba'i myu gu yi// spyod pa spyad dgu yongs la gegs med cing*// bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces bla ma yi dam dkon mchog bstan srung gi tshogs dang bcas pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing 'dod don gegs bral du 'grub pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhed don la gor 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa swasti bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// sar+b+ba ar+tha sid+dhi rastu/ skyabs kyi dam pa sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnams// kun 'dus bdag nyid dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// ci 'dod dngos grub bslu med sbyin pa'i phyag /ring por brkyang ba yi dam lha yi tshogs// rdzu 'phrul mthu chen gur mgon lcam dral dang*// zhal bzhi dpal mgon sring bzhi dregs pa'i 'khor// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming sring sde// dmag zor rgyal mo beg tse lcam dral sogs// bsten cing 'go ba'i lha srung thams cad la// sna tshogs mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te// bcol ba'i snying po gzhan don byang chub kyi// lam mchog don gnyer dad can sbyin pa'i bdag /sgo gsum 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i nad gdon bgegs// phrag dog sems 'chang gzhan gyi bsam sbyor las// rtsub mor brtsams pa'i byad gtad mnan sogs kyi// nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// rigs stobs chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor gyis// khengs ldan skye bo thams cad pad+ma'i tshal// rkang drug dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen bzhin du// brtan pa rang dbang 'gugs pa'i phrin las sgrubs// bsod nams rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang bzang la// 'chi med tshe yi ka ba rab brling zhing*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor mi zad legs bris pa'i// dbang thang 'di na 'phos snyam rgyas par mdzod// zhi las bdud rtsis mnyen par mi nus pa'i// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i tsher ma gzings pa'i nags// drag sbyor bskal pa'i zhugs lces yongs zos nas// gnod bya gnod byed bde la sbyor mdzod cig

/rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung dam tshig dang*// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu nus kyis// ji ltar 'dod gsol snye ma g.yur za ba'i// dga' ston phun tshogs gegs med spyod gyur cig /ces dkon mchog gsum dang bstan bsrung rnams la 'dod don gsol ba bsam don lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang sa skyong bla ma chen po'i phrin las pa mgon pos ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ mkhyen brtse nus gter bla ma lha// thugs rjes mi bslu dkon mchog gsum// phrin las myur ma dpa' mo rnams// skyabs med skyabs su la gor spyon// rdo rje 'chang chen sa skya pa// e waṃ pa sogs dngos brgyud kyi// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' lung dang*// dam tshig rjes skyong srung ma'i mchog /rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas// bka' sdod las mgon pho nya'i tshogs// dmag zor rgyal mo dur khrod bdag /zhing skyong dregs pa sde brgyad sogs// bsten cing 'go ba'i lha srung rnams// myur ba mgon med mgon nyid du// 'bod cing bskul ba'i 'phrin la gson// bstan pa de 'dzin mchog rnams dang*// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba sras bcas la// skyabs su song ba'i dad pa can// da ltar mgon med 'khyams pa 'di// nyes med mi bdag chad pa yis// 'tshe zhing mi srun gyis bdas pa'i// 'jigs pa 'di yis mi zin par// srung dang bskyab dang sba ba mdzod// mgon med 'di yi mgon mdzod cig /skyabs med 'di yi skyabs mdzod cig /thugs rje mthu stobs mi rtul bar// 'jigs med btsan sar skyel mdzod cig /byang chub bar gyi bar chad bdud// srung ba'i srung mar bsten byas na// deng gi 'jigs phran 'di nyid las// mi skyob na ni yi chad dogs// de bas lha srung mthu ma chung*// de bas lha srung rtsal ma zhan// mgon med mgon pa'i dus la bab// skyabs med skyob pa'i dus la bab// bros na thar ba'i srung ma mdzod// gab na sgrib pa'i srung ma mdzod// khros pa zhi ba'i srung ma mdzod// gdug pa byams pa'i srung ma mdzod// bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje che// bka' srung mthu chen grub pa'i gtam// bden pa de yis de skad du// gsol btab 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang tshe 'di'i skyabs mgon gyis dben pa'i slob 'bangs zhig brnag pa'i gnas su 'chol ched/
