ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis dkon mchog gi thugs rje bskul te 'phral du bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// bud+dhā mo gha sid+dhā ya na maḥ bsam don 'grub pa'i bden dpang bla ma dang*// bsam don dngos grub bde ster lhag pa'i lha// bsam don phrin las sgrub pa'i bstan srung tshogs// bsam don 'di dag 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// bdag cag sbyin bdag mi dang nor phyugs bcas// dgra 'dre 'byung gdon gyis gtses 'chi srid dang*// gzhan sdes 'phrog 'joms smra mchu ngan pa'i sri// slad du mi 'byung bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod// mya ngan sdug bsngal sri las nges thar pa// rnyi las grol ba'i 'dab chags rigs mthun khyur// 'phur lding bag yangs rgyu ltar bde skyid dang*// bde rgyu dge ba bcu la spyod par mdzod// ces pa'i 'dod gsol nyung ngu 'di'ang nye bar gnas pa lhun grub phun tshogs kyi ngor ban+de tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// na mo3 mo ghā sid+dhā ya/ gsol btab mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs// mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam mi khyab// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dgongs// deng 'dir rang gis nyes pa'am// gzhan gyis dbyen 'byed byas kyang rung*// rgyal po'i chad pas phog gyur pa'i// skyabs med kun gyi skyabs su mdzod// 'jigs pa kun las da lta nyid// sgrol mdzad thugs rje'i phyag rkyong la// nyes med thar pa bde ba'i grong*// myur du 'jug pa'i skyabs mgon mdzod// ces pa'i skyabs 'jug gi 'dod don gsol ba 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ rgyalaṃ kun yon tan gzi mdangs bsdus pa'i gzugs// blo ldan rab dgaṃ'i dpal bskyed thig le'i dpyid// lung rtog yon tan lang tsho'i mtshar sdug gi /mkhyen bzang mes po'i brtan pa 'phrog byed poṃ// gang sku dbang po'i dwangs ma'i yul gyur dang*// skal mnyam zhal skyin mthong don che ba la// skabs gsum gos kyis nyer mtshon mchod sprin gyis// kun gsal yongs khyab mchod pa'i che bas bdag

/gzhar yang khyod bstan dri med yongs bzung nas// mkhas tshul gsum gyi las snang dkar po'i rgyun// 'thungs las skyes pa'i ngur smrig 'chang mchog gis// 'dzam gling dbyig 'dzin khur du lci bar mdzod// ces lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang gi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku brnyan la snyan shal zhal byang du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ gser mngal can sogs 'jig rten che dgu'i gtsug /zhabs sen dmar 'od sar pas ngal gso zhing*// zab yangs dam chos snang bas 'gengs byed pa// zas gtsang sras mtshon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la// dngos 'byor yid sprul me tog bdug pa'i sprin// mun sel mar me'i phreng sogs nyer spyod dang*// lha rdzas gos sogs 'dod dgu'i dpal gyis mchod// dge 'dun rgya mtsho bsnyen bkur dge bas bdag /skye kun rgyal gsung dri med yongs bzung nas// mkhas tshul gsum gyis dga' ston dpag yas rgyun// 'thungs skyes bshad sgrub smra mkhas grangs med kyis// 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs mdzes par shog /ces lhun grub steng 'du ba chen po'i skabs kyi 'dus tshogs su mang ja'i bsnyen bkur stob pa'i tshe dri gtsang khang gi thub chen gyi sku brnyan la snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza ya tu/ byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i bla ma lha// bar chad rkyen gzhil bsam don kun bsgrub pa'i// rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon dmag zor la sogs bstan srung tshogs// dgyes bskyed shis pa'i mtshan ris bkra ba'i dar// stong 'khun 'phrul bzos btags pas nye bar mtshon// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mdun bdar te// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang byas pa'i// byin rlabs mi dman grags pa'i mu khyud kyis// mthu stobs zho 'thungs rdo rje nyer thogs nas// nad gdon bar chad ri bo'i rgyun lugs dag

/yongs bcad bde 'byor dpal la spyod par mdzod// ces mgon khang chen po snyan shal 'bul ba'i tshe ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza ya tu/ gang zhig skyabs su bsten cing mchod byas pas// bsod nams klung brgya 'jo ba'i yon tan gter// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// mchog gsum bstan pa skyong ba nor sbyin bcas// yang 'byung skye bar mi 'bral rjes gzung slad// yul mchog kun la mchod cing bsnyen bkur bstabs// sdig ltung mthol bshags 'khor 'das dge bar dga'// smra mchog chos sgra 'byin cing brtan bzhugs gsol// dge bas dus 'das phun tshogs bzang po'i rgyud// tshogs gnyis rtsal rdzogs bde ba can skyes nas// 'od dpag med las dam chos thos don rtogs// rnam grol sprul pas gzhan don byed par shog /ces pa'i yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus don gnyer kun dga' bsod nams pa'i ngor bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// bi dza ya tu/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter gyur bla ma dang*// dngos grub 'dod 'jo yi dam zhi khro'i lha// bar chad mthar mdzad bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dgyes bskyed mchod 'bul bzhes nas rtse gcig dgongs// bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i sku tshe bsring*// bstan 'dzin skyes bus dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor khyab// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub phrin las rab rgyas pas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// gzugs can gzugs med kyis bsdus gegs byed kyi// sdang gdug bsam sbyor ngan pa'i ri bo'i 'gros// mthu stobs thogs med lha dbang rdo rje yis// las ngan rgyun lugs gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces mgon khang rnams su snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol du kun dga' lhun grub kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/

bsam kun rdzogs byed yon tan dpag bsam gyis// bsam yas 'gro ba'i re skong bla ma dang*// bsam bya'i snying po'i dngos grub ci dang ci'i// bsam don kun sbyin yi dam rgyu sde'i lha// rgyal ba de sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bkas// bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu bcas skyong bar// ston pa'i thugs sprul gur mgon lcam dral dang*// las bzhi lhun grub dpal mgon sring bzhir bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sde// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// rnam 'dren bstan pa srung ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che ba'i tshogs rnams dgongs// deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis// rang gzhan don du byang chub spyad spyod pa'i// 'chi med ring por 'tsho ba tshe yi rgyun// gaṅgā'i klung ltar bsring ba'i phrin las mdzod// bsod nams dpal 'byor chu gter 'khyil pa'i klong*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan nor bus gtams// mkhas pa'i phrin las dag byed rgyun ring mas// bstan 'gro'i dge legs rgyas pa'i gsos su smin// bsam don brtsams pa'i las rnams thams cad la// thog mtha' bar gyi gnas skabs thams cad du// gegs med shis pa'i sgo 'phar bye ba rgya// cig car 'byed pa'i phrin las thogs med sgrubs// 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba po// brtse chen snying po brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// rtsom 'chad brtsad pa'i lugs bzang lhur len pa'i// ngur smrig 'chang bas sa stengs mdzes gyur cig /maṅga laṃ bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro la gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan// gzhar yang 'dzums pa mi mnga' thugs rje'i gter// dpal ldan bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// bka' srung nor lha'i mchod yul mchis so cog /deng 'dir mthong na mngon dga'i gan+dho lar// rig pa 'dzin mchog 'dus pa'i sngags spyod kyis// snying po bde chen 'dzin pa thar pa'i grong*// gser ri'i grangs ldan nyid du mngon bsgrubs nas// stong 'khun yul gyi mi bdag bsod nams mtsho// bsrubs pa las byung rgyu spun phun tshogs dag

/sprul pa'i bzo bos thags su nyer bskrun pa'i// rmad byung gan gos las grub bla res mtshon// bshams dang sprul pa'i mchod sprin dpag yas kyis// mngon par mchod de dkyil 'khor chen por bdag /'jug cing dbang dang dam tshig sdom pa'i rgyas// mchog dngos grub pa de srid 'bral med bcings// dge ba'i nyal 'gros dpaṃl ldaṃn bla ma mchog /choṃs kyi rgyal thabs skyongaṃ ba gang de yi// byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho yongs gang nas// bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsam kun rdzogs byed shog /brtse chen snying po thabs shes yi ge'i bdag /zung gi lugs mchog bshad sgrub lhur len pa'i// ha ri tsan+dan rkang 'thung rgyas pa'i dris// srid gsum sdug bsngal gdung ba bsil byed shog /ces rnam gnon gyi lor gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' bar dge 'dun 'dus tshogs chen pos ngor lugs dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod 'phar ma dang gan gos kyi bla re bcas sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pas phul ba'i zhal byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis gleng ba'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje zlos pa'i gar// theg gsum bstan pa yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen tshul// khams gsum 'gro la legs pa'i lam ston byed// skyabs gsum 'dus zhal dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs// dad gsum lus btud phyag 'tshal mchod pas mchod// sgo gsum sdig bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// theg gsum chos 'khor bskor dang brtan bzhugs gsol// dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub che phyir bsngo// gdan gsum kun tshang bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyun// gnas gsum sa gzhir rma med btab las skyes// rnam gsum mkhas tshul dbyar skyes phreng 'khrigs rtser// sku gsum lhun grub snye ma g.yur zar shog /ces sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pas mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i sku gdung za ma tog la lcags 'brug lo gsar gyi tshe snyan shal 'bul ba'i zhal byang du ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa dge'o//

// ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ dpag yas bskal pa'i gdod mar sangs rgyas nas// slar yang bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i 'od po ches// skye dgu'i sgrib gsum mun pa bcil ba dang*// dge legs 'dab stong 'dzum bsu shākya'i tog /gang sku rgyal kun 'dus zhal rin po cher// grangs med lus btud phyag 'tshal mchod pas mchod// sdig ltung mthol bshags srid zhi'i dge la rang*// smra mchog chos 'khor bskor dang brtan bzhugs gsol// 'dis mtshon dge bas byang chub bar du bdag /ltos bcas skye ba'i phreng bar sdom gsum ldan// gtsug lag kun rig mkhas tshul rnam gsum gyis// rgyal bstan ring 'tsho'i bya ba byed por shog /ces lcags 'brug cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes la gtsug lag khang mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i thub chen gyi sku la snyan shal mchod 'bul bgyis pa'i tshe bsngo byang 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// bcom ldan nyi ma'i gnyen gyis mtshon// phyogs bcur 'tsho gzhes stobs bcu pa'i// spyan sngar ji snyed gzugs sgra dri// ro bda' reg bya'i mchod sprin 'bul// 'di nas 'tsho ba'i dus byas pa// sangs rgyas seng ge zhes bya ba// ngan 'gro gsum dang mi khom gnas// skye sgo khegs par byin gyis rlobs// gru 'dzin bde ba can zhing du// thogs med bgrod pa'i lus rten gyis// byang chub lam kun rdzogs byas nas// rnam mkhyen thob par byin rlobs shig /'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// shrī shākya mu na ye na maḥ sgron me'i bskal pa'i tshigs bzang lding khang du// bskal bzang rgyal ba'i ma zlums stong gsal las// dus 'dir 'tshang rgya'i thugs bskyed smon pa'i lam// phul byung khyung sngon skyes drangs shāṃkyaṃ'i toṃg 1 /mi mchog gang gi sngon rabs da ltar gyi// legs mdzad gting mthas dben pa stobs bcu pa// rang gi ye shes dag pa'i smyu gu'i rtses// bris pa lags gsungs phung por bkra byas pa/

2 /srid zhi'i brjod bya mtha' dag snyan dngags glur// 'dzad med len pa ngag gi gces mdzod dgu// mtsho byung sgeg mos legs byin dgeṃ baṃ'i dbaṃng*// sras bcas grags pa'i zla 'od 'dzam gling dkar/ 3 /sa dbang dad gsum chu gter rnam 'dren gyi// byin rlabs thugs rje'i man+dā ras bskul tshe// zla bral rtogs brjod gsar pa'i dpaṃg bsaṃm gyi// 'khriṃ shiṃng yal 'dab chig brgya brgyad ldan 'khrungs/ 4 /gser ldan 'bri klung 'gram ngogs ri bo'i shod// sa 'dzin mgoṃn poṃ rnam par rgyaṃl ba'i lhas// bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog la// dad dang gtong ba'i sgo brgya phye ste bskul/ 5 /'chos skyob de nyid kyis bstan brjod bya'i gzugs// dkar 'jam ras kyi gzhi ma de nyid

25 grangs// 'god pa gang tshe rin chen rtsig logs su// bden bral gzugs brgya snang ba'i ngo mtshar 'gog 6 /rnam 'dren bzhi bas zhing sbyangs sems can khams// smin byas spyod pa rmad byung rang gzhan rgyud// sngon med dad pa'i sa bon gdab pa dang*// srid par nges 'byung myu gu bskyed phyir du/ 7 /bsod nams zhing mchog rgyal ba'i sku brnyan gyi// byed po tshuṃl khriṃms riṃn cheṃn bod de yis// bstan bcos dgongs don ma nor ri mo'i lam// rang gi sug bris tshar du dngar ba'i tshe/ 8 /ngo mtshar rjod byed thams cad gzugs brnyan du// shar ba'i mig 'phrul 'di 'dra sngan chad ngas// yid la dran par ma gyur tshangs pa'i blo// 'gyod pa'i gdung bas gnyid la ma yur snyam/ 9 /dbang gzhu'i lang tsho bkra yang dge bas stong*// sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'bum phrag 'bras bus dben// su zhig mthong na dad dang nges 'byung dpal// skye byed tshul 'di 'god nus skal ba bzang*/ 10 /slar yang mkha' dbyings zla ba gcig nyid las// chu snod du mar snang ba'i don byed ltar// sangs rgyas phrin las 'bab stegs mos pa'i phyogs// nges par gzhol la nye dang ring mi mnga'/ 11 /gcig tu dge spyod dge bas ngoms min yang*// gzhan don gyur na mos pa'i phyogs btang ba// chu bdag chu klung bye bas mi tshim mod// chu rgyun grangs med 'gyed pa ma mthong ngam/ 12 /gang phyir dgeṃ slongaṃ tshulaṃ khriṃms tingaṃ 'dziṃn gyis// bka' lung 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos tshogs dang*// phan tshun dge ba'i lag sbrel thub dbang gi /spyan sngar tshogs bsags smon lam lhan cig btab/ 13 /tshul 'di 'driṃ dang yoṃn sbyoraṃ mchoṃd kyiṃn rjeṃd// 'bad pas nyer mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i klung*// ji snyed byang chub mchog gi sin+dhu cher// yongs smin sku gsum rin chen 'byung phyir bsngo/ 14 /de srid skye ba brgyud mar dal 'byor gyi// sdong bur mtho ris yon tan pad+ma dkar// 'dzum brgya dmul bas bslab khrims nyi ma'i 'od// ci yang 'thung ba'i skal ba sbom por shog

15 /thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung*// ji bzhin dpyod pa'i blo gros spobs pa gzungs// cher bsnyes blo ldan la 'os las kun la// dbang 'byor thub pa'i lugs bzang zin par shog 16 /gtong dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus rtsom// bsam gtan shes rab thabs mkhas smon pa'i lam// sgrib bral ye shes dam pa'i spyod gru yis// tshogs gnyis chu gter pha rol phyin par shog 17 /sbyin dang snyan smra'i yid 'phrog 'dzum dkar gyis// dge ba'i lam du 'gro ba kun yid bsu// don spyod don mthun bsdu dngos ro bda'i dpal// rang gzhan thar pa'i gsos su 'gyed par shog 18 /mthar thug mtshan dpes legs brgyan rgyal ba'i sku// sna tshogs mos par sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// khams gsum skye dgu'i brten pa yongs phrogs nas// zab yangs chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog 19 /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi thugs rje dang*// 'dri byed yon sbyor lhag bsam bden pa'i mthus// gang dag smon lam snying po 'di nas bzung*// byang chub bar du gegs med smin gyur cig 20 /thugs bskyed thog ma'i sa bon rma med btab// skal mang spyod pa'i dpag bsam lo 'dab bskyed// spangs rtogs mthar phyin snye ma cang smin pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog 21 /ces sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing gi gzugs bkod bris thang nyi shu rtsa lnga ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bsngo ba smon lam du bcas pa'i dpag bsam gyi lcug phran zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ldan shod sa 'dzin mgon po rnam rgyal dang se na shu bha'i par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pa rten bzhengs kyi sbyin bdag tu gyur pa zung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ bzo gnas rig pa'i gtsug lag smra ba ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i lcags 'brug gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dge ba'i nyin sbyar ba dge legs dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig

/maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// bskal pa bzang po'i nam mkha'i me long du// rnam 'dren chos kyi nyi ma stong phrag bzhin// shar dang 'char 'gyur gsung rab 'phang 'gro'i rgyud// thos pa'i sor rtses bsnun las 'phos pa'i sku// rgyal rnams dngos su mjal dang bsod nams mthu// skal ba phra mo gzhar yang min snyam gyi// snang brnyan rin chen gser sbyangs khams kyi rgyus// lus can yongs kyi bsod nams zhing du bskrun// yid srubs thul mchog rnams kyi gzugs brnyan ni// bus pa'i rtse 'jos bskrun pa tsam gyis kyang*// dpag yas legs byas yul du bsngags brjod na// tshad ldan gzugs sku'i bsod nams pha mtha' ci// gang 'di thub pa'i brtul zhugs nyer blangs nas// dkon mchog skyabs su bsten pa'i btags ming du// tshul khrims rab brtan zhes bya mi bdag gi /bka' yi las byed pa des dad pas bzhengs// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i 'od brgya pas// sdig ltung kun 'byung sdug bsngal bcas pa'i mun// legs sbyangs thar pa'i lam kun snang byas nas// byang chub yon tan 'dab stong grol gyur cig /ces dge slong don grub can gyis bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi snang brnyan thang sku gser ri'i grangs ldan bzhengs byang dang smon lam du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// //na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gang gi snang brnyan ti se lhun po'i dpal// mthong thos byin rlabs lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun// ngan 'gro gsum gyi sdug bsngal de rgyu'i dri// sbyong byed rgyal po kun rig rtsa ba'i lha// dus 'khor sdom 'byung gshin rje'i dgra la sogs// kun mkhyen gyis gsungs tshad dang mtshan nyid las// legs par 'phos pa'i rnam bkra dbang po'i tshon// lang tsho gsar par co 'drir bzod pa gang*// tshul khrims rab brtan gyis bskrun bsod nams kyis// zla gzhon snang bas sgo gsum sdig ltung mun// legs sbyangs tshogs gnyis sa dga' bzhad pa las// don gnyis ro bda'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog

/ces dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan pas sgo gsum sdig ltung sbyong byed du kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan bris pa'i bsngo byang du ban+de tshul rin can gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// na mo gu rwa k+ṣo bh+yash+tsa bh+yaṃ/ gang mtshan snyan pa'i rol mo su zhig gi /thos pa 'dzin pa'i bcud du lhung ba'am// gzugs brnyan mig gi me long shar tsam gyis// tshe rabs phreng ba'i sgrib sbyong mi 'khrugs pa// gang sku de nyid grangs 25 mnyam brgyud rim bcas// bkod legs ri mor bris pa'i ltad mo yis// dpyod ldan lta byed brtan pa khengs ldan gzhu// kha gsag rgyud la ma brten rang dbang 'gugs// 'phags yul gsang chen grub pa'i dbang phyug gis// legs bkral sngags kyi cho ga rjes mthun du// phun tshogs rgyu sbyor bkod pa nyer sbyar te// dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan can gyis bskrun// de las byung ba'i bsod nams nyal 'gro'i char// dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas ji snyed klung*// thabs mkhas bsngo ba'i rgyal pos legs bsdams nas// byang chub mchog gi chu gter ro gcig shog /srid par sdom ldan pad+ma'i tshul bzung yang*// sems kyi gnyis 'thung dkar min gom stabs kyis// nongs gyur tshe rabs sdig dang lhan cig nyid// legs sbyangs yon tan sbrang rtsis gtams gyur cig /ces dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan pa rang gi sdig sbyong du rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i gtso 'khor gyi sku brnyan gyi bris sku'i bsngo byang du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// na moḥshrī māṃ dharma pā lā ya/ dpaṃl ldan rdo rje 'chang ba ngur smrig 'chang*// mchog gi rol pas dam choṃs skyoṃng ba la// zla bral srung mas phrin las nyer bsgrubs pa'i// mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po'i pur ras gzhir// sgeg chags mi sdug nyams kyi 'gyur ba res// zhi rgyas dbang dang bskrad gzir phrin las rnams// lhun grub rgyal ba'i thugs sprul gur mgon che// lcam dral gdong bzhi las byed mgon por bcas// gar dgu'i nyams ldan legs bskrun gzugs sku 'dir// rang rang brten gnas nyid du rnam brtags pas// mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mgon po yang*// dgyes pa'i gar gyis rtsen pa som nyi ci// gang 'di bstan pa lhun grub gyis bskrun mthus// rgyal bstan de 'dzin yon sbyor bcas pa la// bar chad sdang dgra skad cig tshar bcad cing*// bshad sgrub phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// mdo sngags chos tshul 'dab stong bzhad pa las// thos bsam bsgom pa'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud len gyis// blo gros bung ba 'phur rtsal rab rdzogs nas// don gnyis lhun grub dbyangs snyan sgrogs par mdzod// ces bstan pa lhun grub kyis gur mgon 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan pur ras la bzhengs pa'i 'dod gsol du ban+de tshul rin gyis smras pa'o//

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gnas skabs mthar thug don kun grub pa'i gzhi// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che'i// zhal lung ji bzhin byams chen rgyal ba'i sku// bskrun 'dir thog ma bar dang mtha' kun du// sbyin bdag 'go 'dzin las byed bcas pa la// mi dang mi min bsam sbyor gdug rtsub kyi// kha rlangs las byung nad rims gdon bgegs kyi// nyer 'tshes mi tshugs bsrung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dang*// legs phyogs thams cad dbyar dus che gter bzhin// gong nas gong 'phel khyed bzhed don rnams kun// gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong ba'i bzhed pa rdzogs byed du byams chen rgyal ba'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bskrun par brtsams pa'i nyin/ tsan+dan dkar bsil gyi za ma tog tu bzhugs pa'i sku gdung la gegs bral gnang ba zhu ba'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi /'dren mchog dpal ldan chos skyong bar byon pa'i// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yi dam lha// gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan pa che// las mgon pu tra ming sring dmag zor sogs// rnam 'dren bstan srung rgya mtsho da tshur gson// byams chen rgyal ba'i sku brnyan bskrun pa sogs// yongs 'dzin bzhed don bsgrub pa'i g.yar dam can// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'go 'dzin las byed bcas// nad rims gdon bgegs mi dang mi min gyi// nyer 'tshe bar chad mi 'byung srung ba mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// rnam dkar phrin las spyi dang bye brag tu// gang brtsams bgyi ba gegs med bde blag tu// myur mgyogs 'grub pa'i phrin las stong grogs mdzod// ces byams chen rgyal ba'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bskrun pa'i 'go brtsams pa'i nyin/

rkyen gegs mi 'byung ched du lhun grub steng gi mgon khang chen por gtor bsngo phrin las 'chol dus su ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa bkra shis// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ bsam kun rdzogs byed yon tan dpag bsam gyis// bsam yas 'gro ba'i re skong bla ma dang*// bsam bya'i snying po'i dngos grub ci dang ci'i// bsam don kun sbyin yi dam rgyud sde'i lha// rgyal ba de sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bkas// bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu bcas skyong bar// ston pa'i thugs sprul gur mgon lcam dral dang*// las bzhi lhun grub dpal mgon sring bzhir bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sde// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// bsten kyin bsgrub pa'i bka' srung rgya mtsho'i sde// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag yas tshogs rnams dgongs// deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis// rang gzhan don du byang chub spyad spyod pa'i// 'chi med ring por 'tsho ba tshe yi rgyun// skal ldan shing rta ltar bsring phrin las mdzod// bsod nams dpal 'byor chu gter 'khyil pa'i klong*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan nor bus gtams// mkhas pa'i phrin las dag byed rgyun ring mas// bstan 'gro'i dge legs rgyas pa'i gsos smin mdzod// bsam don brtsams pa'i las rnams thams cad la// thog mtha' bar gyi gnas skabs thams cad du// gegs med shis pa'i sgo 'phar bye ba brgya// cig car 'byed pa'i phrin las thogs med sgrubs// 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal// brtse chen snying po brgyud par bcas pa'i lugs// rtsom 'chad brtsad pa lhur len ngur smrig 'chang*// 'du tshogs khur gyis dbyig 'dzin lci bar mdzod// ces sde dge lhun grub steng gi mgon khang chen por rang gis 'dod don snying po bsgrub phyir gtor bsngo dang mngon 'dod phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis rnam gnon gyi lor bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// swasti sid+dhiḥ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang ba nas// kho bo'i 'dren pa mchog rnams bar byon pa'i// dbang brgyud gdams pa dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha dang dkon mchog gsum// bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon rdo rje gur// lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan pa sring bzhir bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sde// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// bstan srung dam can thams cad mthu stobs shugs// gnam lcags thog brgya dus gcig 'khrugs ltar bskyed// deng 'dir phrin las sgrub par bcol la dgongs// bdag cag bstan 'gro'i don sgrub bsam sbyor la// phrag dog sems 'chang dgra bgegs byad mkhan gyis// rbad pa'i sde brgyad rgyal 'gong 'byung gdon gyi// nyer 'tshe zhi zhing mi 'byung phrin las sgrubs// zhi byed las kyi bdud rtsis ma thul ba'i// gdug can mi dang mi min gang yang rung*// bstan srung rnams kyi mthu rtsal dpung bskyed la// bzung dang bcing brdeg 'tsho ba'i rgyun bcad nas// rnam shes skye med dbyings su sbyor sgrol mdzod// ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams chu gter klong*// bsam bsgom yon tan rgyas pa'i gdengs can dbang*// srid zhi'i dge legs dbyig la dbang 'byor zhing*// phrin las chu klung phyogs brgyar 'gyed mdzod cig /sa skya pa dang e waṃ yi ge'i bdag /mchog zung lugs bzang bshad sgrub glur 'jo ba'i// bstan skyong ngang pa'i rgyal po grangs med kyis// phyogs dang phyogs bral rgya mtshor khyab par mdzod// bla ma lha srung byin rlabs nus mthu'i gter// grags pa'i rnga gsang srid pa gsum ldir ba'i// bden pa de yis gang bcol phrin las rnams// gegs med la gor 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes lhun grub steng gi mgon khang chen po shar nub gnyis su rang gis 'dod don 'ga' zhig sgrub ched las bcol rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga gsang zhes pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rnam gnon gyi lo'i tha skar zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la bris pa bi dza yan+tu//

// ༄༅// swasti sid+dhi rastu/ gang dag mtshan gyi rnga bo che// rtse gcig mos pa'i dbyig gus bskul// bsam dgu 'grub pa'i dbyangs ldir ba// skyabs mchog bslu med kun gyis skyong*// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras bcas dang*// bstan dgra dam nyams tshar gcod rje// khrag 'thung rdo rje gur mgon ni// sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum sder bcas// bstan dgra'i srog zan 'dod khams bdag /nam gru ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dam nyams dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog byed// gnyan mgon zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa// sring bzhi bka' sdod shan pa'i sde// snang srid dregs pa'i sde dang bcas// las mkhan gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// khams gsum srog bdag bdud pu tra// bha ṭa srin mo kha 'bar ma// rgyud gsum gyis bsdus dregs pa'i tshogs// ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag dpung dang*// dur khrod dmag zor rgyal mo che// 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje ni// 'khor tshogs gshin rje grangs med bcas// bsten kyin bsgrub pa'i lha srung kye// rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa// bdag gi yongs 'dzin bar byon pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos dang*// rdo rje'i tha tshig dran byos la// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub la dgongs// chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa'i// mi rgyud chos brgyud bcas spel zhing*// rgyal ba kun bzang brgyud bcas kyi// bstan srid rgyas dang rgyas 'gyur la// gegs byed sdang dgra bsgral nas kyang*// bshad sgrub phrin las rgyas par mdzod// bdag cag slob 'khor bcas pa la// dgra bgegs byad ma gang dag gis// mnan gtad bcings dang ngan sngags zor// bsam sbyor rtsub mor rtsom byed pa'i// dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma yi// mthu stobs nus pa nyams kyis la// byad ma de thog bzlog cing bsgyur// bsad bcas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod// ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad char phob// lo zlar ma 'gyangs da lta nyid// gsod gcod bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod// sod rtags don snying dmar po'i skyes// da lta nyid du mi ster na// mthu chen srung ma'i dbang po rnams// ngal brgyas bsten pa'i dgos pa ci// bstan dgra dam nyams mi bsgral na// bstan pa bstan 'dzin ji ltar bsrung*// bsgos pa'i phrin las mi bsgrubs na// khas blangs dam tshig ji ltar bsrung*// des na dgra bo byad ma yi// tshe dang bsod nams lhag ma bstung*// srog rtsa chod la snying khrag 'thung*// don snying sha khrag tshogs su rol// bstan dgra 'di rnams ring gnas na// bstan pa bshig cing bstan 'dzin 'tshe// chos dang bla ma'i sku dgrar byed// de bas myur du bsgral mdzod cig

/bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas// gegs chag rkyen las rnam rgyal nas// ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal// lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par spel// bde dga' bsam bsgom yon tan dang*// mkhas tshul gsum gyi phrin las rnams// phan tshun gcig la gcig 'gran ltar// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// bla ma yi dam thugs rje dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal gyis// bstan dgra dam nyams tshar gcod cing*// bsam don 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bka' srung dregs pa'i sde tshogs la drag tu bskul pa g.yul bzlog lha dbang dpung bskyed ces bya ba 'di'ang rang gzhan la pha rol gyi byad gtad kyi mtshan ma shar ba'i tshe ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄༅// sar+b+bār+tha sid+dhā ya na maḥ mtshar sdug spyan gyi zur mda' 'phangs tsam nas// srid zhi'i dpal gyis khengs ldan skye bo'i blo// rtse gcig rang dbang nyid du 'gugs pa'i lha// thugs rje myur ma rigs byed dpa' mo'i sku// sprul 'tshong lus dkris tsī na'i 'phrul gos la// yid 'phrog las kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten// tshul rin rang gi sug rtses zlos bu'i gar// dbyu gu gsum yun legs bsgyur rdzogs par bris// dge ba thub mchog bstan pa'i khang bzang du// ris bral 'gro ba mgron du gnyer byas te// zab yangs chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston mkhan// smra mkhas chos kyi sbyin bdag che phyir bsngo// zhes lha mo rigs byed mar 'dod don gsol ba smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// bslu med gtan gyis skyabs gnas// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la// dad gsum sor mos brdungs pa'i// sgra brnyan dbyangs mchod 'bul lo// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs// thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs la// dbyangs mchog rdo rje chos 'drar// bdag la dngos grub stsol shog

/ka ra mngar po'i zas de// kha la mur ba'i dga' ba// ga ler snying la sim pas// nga rang skal ba bzang byung*// ca co khe spogs gtam dang*// cha lugs sog chas med kyang*// ja tsam bdud rtsi'i chab tu// nya mo nga rang skyid snyam// ta la'i gzhi mar bris pa'i// tha dad yig rigs mthong tshe// da lta na tshod rgas kyang*// na rga 'ong snyam mi byed// pa tra drang srong snod nang*// pha mes gnang ba'i gdugs tshod// ba mo'i 'o ma bzhin du// ma ltogs tsam gyis los chog /tsa la

g.yo ba/ bcud kyi sha khrag /tsha drod yal long med par// dza re kha la 'jug pas// wa mo bdag kyang skrag byung*// zha ma dad pa/ mi 'dzem pa/ mi brtson pa/ long lkugs pa'i rigs la// za ma zhim dgu byin yang*// 'a 'ur khyi skad 'don na// ya mtshan gleng mos ci bya// rwa ba gangs kyis bskor ba'i// la klung gang phyin de de'i// sha za 'dra ba'i sems rgyud// sa gzhi gshin ltar mnyed gyur// ha has dam pa'i chos la// ha cang grub rtags ma snga// a ho brtson 'grus spyod dang*// a re dga' ba thob 'ong*// i 'di la maṃ 'bad pa'i dge bas/ /rgya mtsho/ ud dhi mtshungs 'gro rnams// e 'di skad waṃ bdag thos chos la// o zas/ da naṃ ltar spyod gyur// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad// rnam par rgyal ba'i bkra shis// pi wang glu ru longs shog /gangs can brda dang mthun pa'i// dbyangs gsal sgra brnyan rgyud 'di// tshul khrims rin chen bod pas// shugs byung sor mos bsgyur ro// zhes pa'i glu chung 'di ko /sgra brnyan dbyangs kyi 'tsho bas// snying la kun dga' ster phyir// kun du rgyu phyir bris so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ byin rlabs thugs rje phrin las myur ba'i gter// dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po yi dam lha// mchog gsum chos skyong nor lha kun gyi dngos// skyabs mchog bla ma'i sku gdung mchod sdong cher// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags// dge tshogs la dga' smra mchog chos ston gsol// 'gro don bzhugs par gsol 'debs rnam dkar dge /khyod zhabs skye bar len phyir yongs su bsngo// de srid skye bar kun dga'i dal 'byor thob// tshul khrims skyon bral thos bsam bsgom brtson pas// zab yangs chos tshul kun la dbang 'byor zhing*// bstan dang sems can phan 'dogs byed par shog /ces dpal chos pa'i sku gdung la kun dga' chos 'byor gyis mchod 'bul gyi tshe gsol 'debs su ban+de tshul rin gyis so//

// ༄༅// byin rlabs 'byung gnas dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha yi tshogs// srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i dkon mchog gsum// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste// khyad par bsten cing sgrub pa'i bstan srung gtso// rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon pu tra mi sring dur khrod bdag /dmag zor chos rgyal la sogs da tshur gson// dus 'das dge slong rgya mtsho zhes bya ba// ngan 'gro'i skye sgo ngan pa kun 'gegs shing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan bskyed pa dang*// bde ba can sogs mngon 'dod zhing kun skyol// zhing der rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras rnams las// theg mchog bdud rtsi zab yangs thos pa dang*// gzungs dang spobs pas thos don rgyud bskyed nas// don gnyis grub nas skye ba'i stong grogs mdzod// de thob bar gyi yang srid thams cad du// dal 'byor rten thob dam pa'i chos 'dzin par// yang dag bla ma dam pas rjes bzung nas// lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtshor dbang 'byor mdzod// bla ma lha srung thugs rje nus rtsal gyis// ji ltar gsol ba'i don 'di ma lus pa// gegs med bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du// la gor 'grub pa'i bden mtha' gsal gyur cig /ces pa'i 'dod gsol myur mgyogs 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni dus 'das dge legs rgya mtshos mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas su skye ba'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// ar+tha sid+dhir+bha wa tu/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung gi /rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas te// yid la gang bsams gegs med du// sgrub byed srung ma'i sde dpon che// rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon sring bzhir bcas// las mgon pho mo 'khor bcas sogs// ye shes spyan ldan srung ma'i tshogs// zab gsal gnyis med sku mchog bsgom// grag stong dbyer med gsang sngags bzlas// mi rtog ting 'dzin bsgom tshul gyis// bdag don nyer bsnyen rnal 'byor pas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor dang*// rten rdzas spyan gzigs dkor nor gyi// bshams sprul mchod pas mdun bdar nas// mngon 'dod dngos grub zhu la dgongs// chos dang srid pa zung 'brel ba'i// sa gzhi skyong pa'i mgon po 'di'i// srog lus dbang thang klung rta'i khams// gong nas gong du bskyed mdzod la// lha mi klu yi 'jig rten nas// las bzang bstan jus phan pa'i srid// gang du 'dug kyang tshur khug la// chos skyong mgon gyi sras su stsol// rtsal chen bstan srung chen po rnams// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs cher bskyed de// srid pa'i phun tshogs rigs rgyud bcas// da lta nyid du 'phel bar mdzod// bla ma yi dam thugs rje'i stobs// bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mthu rtsal dang*// rnal 'byor yon sbyor lhag bsam mthus// 'dod don 'bras bu smin gyur cig

/ces 'dzin rnam rgyal mgon khang du 'dod gsol zhu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa don kun 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgya mtsho pa'i gsung bskul phebs ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// a mo gha sid+dhā ya na maḥ rdo rje 'chang dang brtse chen kun bzang gi /bstan pa bsrung spel las la gnyer gtad pa'i// gur mgon gdong bzhi ldan mtshon bstan srung rnams// bdag cag bstan don sgrub pa'i rgyab rten mdzod// de la phrag dog dam nyams byad ma'i rigs// mthu nus bsod nams stobs shugs zad mthar gtugs// las ngan gang brtsams rnam smin da lta der// kun gyis mthong smin bka' chad drag por phob// bstan srung khyed cag mthu rtsal yod na ni// bstan pa'i gzengs bstod bstan dgra mda' lnga'i bdag /mi 'phel rgyun chod skal ba bzang po'i tshul// nyer brdzus sdang dgra tshar gcod phrin las sgrubs// zhes pa 'di'ang don du gnyer ba'i gsung bskul gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa bi dza yastu// // ༄༅// 'dren mchog kun dga' bzang po'i zhal skyin zla// 'gro ba'i blo mtshor shar la dar 'jam bstabs// dge bas tshul khrims rnam dag mkhas tshul gsum// rin chen dga' ston 'gyed por bdag byin rlobs// zhes khyu mchog gi lor rje kun dga' bzang po'i sku brnyan la gsol gdab tu ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ bdag nyid co 'dris lan du'ang sman 'dogs sgrub// sems can phan btags khyed thugs dgyes 'gyur ba// ston mchog thugs rje che dang zhal skyin dag /dbyer med gcig tu dmigs nas sgo gsum brgyud// khyu mchog bgrang gzhi gsar tshes mi mchog gis// cho 'phrul mdzad pas yid srub bcom dus kyi// kun phan dkyil 'khor gang bar thub dbang bka'i// bdud rtsi nod pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags dge bar rang*// smra mchog chos ston bskul zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub bar du khyod bstan la// mkhas tshul gsum gyi bya ba bgyi phyir bsngo// zhes yan lag bdun pa 'dod gsol bcas pa nyung ngu 'di'ang khyu mchog gi lor thub chen la mchod 'bul gyi tshe tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o//

//dpal kun 'byung gnas bcom ldan rgyal ba sras// kun 'dus sgyu 'phrul rol pas chos skyong ba// bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin dpal gyi// sku gdung mthong ba skal bzang sgrub pa la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sgo gsum sdig ltung bshags// dge ba'i tshogs la yi rang chos ston bskul// zhi bder mi gzhol 'gro don sgrub par gsol// bsod nams gzhan don byang chub che phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar dal 'byor tshul khrims ldan// gnas lnga'i gzhung lugs legs rtogs blo gros kyis// bstan dang sems can don brtsams gang dang gang*// chos mthun gegs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes yan lag bdun pa 'dod gsol bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngu 'di ni khyu mchog gi 'grang zhir sku gdung mchod 'bul gyi tshe/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ na mo bud+dha a mo gha sid+dha ye/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs drug dga' mar bcas// rgyal ba'i myu gu che brgyad lha mo drug /bgegs 'joms khro bo khro mor bcas pa'i lha// kun 'dus ngo bdag nyid dpal chos skyong rgyal// gang de'i rgyal sras spyod pa rmad byung gis// kha ba'i ljongs kyi dkyil 'khor 'khod dgu rnams// gang 'tsham chos dang srid pa'i dpal kun gyis// sman 'dogs sgrub pa'i rnam thar bsam yas bstan// de mthar myang 'das tha ma'i mdzad pas kyang*// sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong gis// gdul bya rgya mtshor byang chub sa bon bzhag /srid pa ji srid phan 'dogs smon lam btab// rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i legs mdzad pag yas las// yangs pa can du dge 'dun dbyen 'dums tshe// byung ba nyer byas mchod sdong srid dang zhi'i// dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam 'dzam gling rgyan// gang dag nga la gsol btab de dang de'i// snying po bslu med 'byung ba zhal gyis 'ches// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i 'phrin yig yid srubs ste// grangs med cig car lhags kyang gsub du ci// mgon khyod sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i 'phrin// yid kyi ngos gzhir dad gsum smyu gu'i rtses// mngon par bkod kyin dad pa'i yan lag lngas// 'od srungs byin la gtugs pas phyag bgyi'o// sgo gsum rnam dkar lhur bgyis dge ba dang*// bdag lus longs spyod bcas pa mchod pa'i sprin// dpag yas sangs rgyas zhing kun 'gengs bzod pa'i// mchod pa kun gyis rtag tu khyod mnyes bgyi// thog med 'khor bar goms pa'i gnyis 'thung gis// mi dge'i 'dam du dbang bral rkang bkod pa'i// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung mi 'chab par// stobs bzhi rdzogs pa'i cho gas mthol tshang bgyi// 'phags dang so skyer gtogs pa'i 'gro tshogs kyi// bsod nams dbyar skyes rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa la// yi rang sprin gyi rnga yab kyis gtor chus// dge legs lo 'dab phang phung bskyed par bgyi// phyogs bcur 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa'i smra mchog rnams// dbang po rno rtul bar ma'i gdul bya'i blor// gang 'tsham phyi nang theg pa'i chos lam gyi// dga' ston rgyun chags 'gyed par bskul ma gdab// lam gsum 'gro rgyud dri ma 'khrud phyir du// sna tshogs mdzad pa'i gaṅgā'i rgyun phab kyang*// srid pa mtha' can ma gyur skye ba'i thugs// myang 'das dben pa mi 'tshol bzhugs gsol 'debs// de tshul 'bad pa las byung dge ba'i mdas// sgrib gnyis bden bral mgo bo breg ste slar// shes bya kun gzigs yid 'phrog sī ta de// rang dbang khugs pa'i rtse 'jor rol gyur cig

/kun phan gyis bskyed bi shwa na ri'i bu// dngos med mkha' dbyings bcad pa'i sdong dum dag /srid pa min bzhin gsang chen grub pa'i bkas// bslu ba mi srid bden pa dam pas skyongs// bka' 'bangs tshul khrims rin chen can bdag gis// bsam dgu'i snying po thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas// nges par brnyes nas 'gro rnams srid pa las// gdon byed chos kyi nyi mar byin gyis rlobs// de srid skye bar dal 'byor ba ku la// yongs 'dzin dam pa'i 'gram chang gis phye ba'i// blo gros 'dab brgya rnam grol gnas lnga'i gzhung*// thos bsam bung ba'i snyan glur len par mdzod// bsam dang bsgom byung ye shes 'od po ches// chos kun rnam 'byed mkhas pa'i las gsum la// dbang 'byor smra mchog grub pa'i phrin las kyis// rgyal bstan skyong ba'i byed por byin gyis rlobs// snyigs mar gyur pa'i lam stor rmong rtul gyi// 'gro khams 'tsham par mngon mtho nges legs lam// gang dag 'doms pa de yi gnas skabs dang*// mthar thug don chen 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag cag lhag bsam bstan don sgrub dgu la// gegs byed 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs dug /nad gdon nye zho khyod zhar dran pa'i 'phral// mun khrod sgron ma bteg ltar gzhil bar gsol// sdang sems ldan pa'i mi dang mi min gyi// bsam sbyor ngan pas rbod gtong mnan gtad bcing*// dug can zas sbyor gshom rnams gnod byed kho'i// rang srog gcod pa'i spu grir bzlog bsgyur gsol// bstan don byang chub sgrub phyir ring 'tsho'i tshe// bsod nams tshogs dang mkhas pa'i phrin las rnams// skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun dang dbyar gyi mtsho// nyi zla'i 'od ltar kun khyab rgyas byin rlobs// lung rtogs yon tan srid pa'i stobs 'byor gyis// khengs ldan skye 'gros mthong thos reg pa'i 'phral// yid srub kyis sprul mtshar sdug lang tsho mas// 'dod ldan yid ltar rang dbang 'dun par mdzod// las ngan 'khyog por skyes pa'i gnod byed dgras// phrag dog sdang sems tsher rnon gzengs pa'i nags// bstan srung bran du 'khol khyod mthu stobs mes// skad cig mi gnas thal bar brlag mdzod cig

/mdor na ci 'dod dpalaṃ kun 'byung ba'i gzhir// smon lam mthu chen ldaṃn pa'i mgon khyod kyis// kho bos brtsams don thams cad gegs bral du// choṃs mthun 'grub par thugs rjes skyoṃng du gsol// bla ma lha dang bstan srung dbang po rnams// mkhyen brtse nus pa mi zad rgya mtsho'i mched// grub pas mthun min phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i sku gdung gi mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam zhes bya ba bzo'i bya ba nang rten du bcas pa legs par grub nas bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol ba'i dus su/ rang nyid kyis 'dod don gsol gdab kyi tshigs su bcad pa thugs rje'i 'od stong 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun mchog gi gsung las skyes pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ khyu mchog gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rgyu skar dbos nya ba'i tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa phyogs thams cad du dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i mi mchog thams cad kyi// gsang gsum yon tan dpal kun bsdus pa'i gzugs// rgyal sras spyod pas skal ldan smin bgyid cing*// lung rtogs chos tshul skyong bas rtag tu skyongs// 'di na ngur smrig 'chang mchog brtul zhugs kyis// bod yul gdul bya nges legs lam bkod kyang*// mdzad pa thams cad gdul rnams sku gdung gi /mchod rten bzhag pa'i phrin las mu mtha' ci// nyi ma'i gnyen mchog spyod pa dpag yas las// dge 'dun bye ba legs 'dums gang gi tshe// legs par byung de dper mdzad srid dang zhi'i// dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam 'dzam gling rgyan// gang 'di gnas skabs mthar thug sems can gyi// re skong nor bu'i rgyal po 'di mthong tshe// gdengs can gtsug gi nor bus ngan 'gro yi// 'jigs las bsgral ba ma bzod sa 'og bros// srid na mtshungs zlas dben pa skyabs gcig gi

/gsang gsum che ba'i 'phrin yig snying bkod pa'i// shugs 'byung dad pas kun nas bslangs pa'i lus// zhing rdul grangs mnyam sprul pas phyag bgyi'o// stong 'khun yul gyi gan dar gyis mtshon pa'i// dus gsum dge ba lus dang longs spyod rnams// dbyig 'dzin ri gling bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍa lar// mngon par sprul pa'i mchod sprin gya nom 'bul// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sgo gsum sdig ltung dri// mthol tshang stobs bzhi'i byed po'i lag pa yis// legs phyis sems rgyud shel gyi me long du// lung rtogs yon tan gzugs brgya bkra bar bgyi// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das 'gro tshogs kyis// mngon par 'du bgyis legs byas gangs ldan ri'i// rjes su yi rang kun phan gzhon nu yi// 'dzum zer stong gis ches dkar bklubs par bgyi// ngag gi skyon bral smra ba'i dbang phyug rnams// mchu sgros chu skyes bzhad pa'i khong gsing las// gsung dbyangs rkang drug rgyud las 'phos pa'i sgras// gang 'tsham chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ma 'debs// gdul ka'i mi srun spyod tshul tsher ma'i dbal// rtsub mos thugs rje'i lag pa sun bgyis las// skyo zhing dub pa'i stegs la mi yur bar// smon lam rjes dran brtson pa'i go bgos gsol// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i mtho ris nyal 'gro ma// gzhan don mngon 'dod sa gzhir 'khyil ba las// yon tan phrin las rlabs phreng 'bum g.yo ba'i// ston mchog chos kyi chu gter che phyir bsngo// mgon khyod mi pham rgyal ba'i sras mdun sogs// dag zhing gang du bzhugs kyang thugs rje'i shugs// sku dngos gdul byar gyur pa'i lus can phyir// gsol btab 'bras bu rtag 'jo smon lam mthu// sku dbon rin chen mchog tu grub pas mtshon// mgon khyod thugs rje la ltos slob 'khor gyis// sgo gsum 'bad pas thugs rje nam mkha'i mdzod// 'gengs byed lhag bsam skad cig gcig skyes dges// deng nas bzung ste mar gyur 'gro ba'i don// rtog med lhun gyis grub pa'i thams cad mkhyen// mngon du gyur min de srid tshe rabs phreng*// dal 'byor bco brgyad chos ldan nyid byin rlobs// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung gi thos bsam bsgom// mthar phyin lung rtogs yon tan bsam mi khyab// dbang 'byor 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i phrin las kyis// bstan 'gror phan 'dogs 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// rje btsun brtse chen snying po e waṃ pa// zung gi lugs mchog rtsod bral nyin mor byed// gzi brgya 'bar bas 'od srungs byin dkyil 'khor// yongs su khyab bzhin mdzes par byin gyis rlobs// de sogs rang gzhan don chen sgrub pa la// sdang sems ldan pa'i mi dang mi min dang*// 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i nad gdon bar chad rnams// khyod zhal dran pas zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mched lcam lha sras bcas// 'chi med sku tshe 'dzad med bsod nams stobs// chab 'bangs dpal 'byor rgyas pa brgya byin gyi// mnga' thang thams cad 'di na 'phos snyam mdzod// ston mchog chos kyi nyi ma shar ba na// chos min mun pa'i go 'phang 'jig pa dang*// chos kyi snang chen srid gsum yongs khyab pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des 'dir bde legs shog

/ces mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong ba'i sku gdung gi mchod sdong chen po srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam zhes bya ba bzo'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pa sogs kyis bskul ngor/ skyabs mchog dam pa'i bka' 'bangs su gyur pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob brgyud bcas kyi// bka' dang dam tshig la gnas bstan srung mchog /rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon dur khrod 'khor bran dregs pa'i tshogs// thams cad tshur gson kun snying kun dga' bzang*// zung gi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dar zhing rgyas// bstan pa'i las byed bdag cag bsod nams tshe// dpal 'byor phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// de la gegs byed sdang dgra byad gtad mkhan// gang yin lo zlar 'gyang ba'i skabs med par// bsad bcad bsgral nas rnam shes dbyings sbyor ba'i// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul cher bskyed bsam don sgrubs// sar+b+ba sha trūn mā ra ya/ sa ma ya sma ra/ zhes lcags sbrul lor mgon khang gnyis su bskang gso brgya rtsa btang ba'i skabs su 'dod don phrin las gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nas brtse chen zhabs// kun dga' bzang po brgyud bcas bdag cag gi /yongs 'dzin mchog gi bar byon thams cad kyis// bstan pa bstan 'dzin bsrung spel gnyer gtad pa// rdo rje gur mgon lha mo 'dod khams bdag /zhing skyong gdong bzhi sring bzhi dregs pa'i sde// srog bdag gnod sbyin pu tra ming sring dang*// dmag zor la sogs bstan srung tshogs rnams dgongs// rnam 'dren bstan pa rgyas pa'i las sgrub kyin// bstan don lhag bsam mkhas tshul skyong ba la// sngon las 'phral rkyen 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i nad// bar chad 'chi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol// phrag dog dug myos mi srun sbrul gdug gi

/bsam sbyor ngan dgu brtsams pa'i byad gtad mthu// thams cad gnod byed byad mkhan gang yin de// thal bar brlag pa'i bdud du bzlog bsgyur mdzod// mi 'jigs mthu stobs rno mtshon 'bum gdengs pas// bstan dgra dam nyams byad ma gar mchis kyang*// rings par bkug nas bsad bcas dum bur gtubs// las ngan rgyun bcad rnam shes dbyings su sgrol// bdag cag 'khor bcas tshe yi gaṅgā bsring*// bsod nams sa gzhi brling bar bsam bsgom gyi// dbyar skyes phreng 'khrigs 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i las// dbyar dus chu gter 'phel ba'i rjes smin mdzod// bka' nyan dam tshig mi bsrungs dam can min// bstan pa srung spel mi byed chos skyong min// bcol don thogs med mi sgrub las mkhan min// phyi rabs sngags 'chang sun phyung su la re// de phyir bstan pa'i lha srung rtag 'go zhing*// brtsams dgu'i bgyi ba kun la gegs med par// ji skad smras don snye ma g.yur za bas// rang gzhan don gnyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsal khyu mchog gi gnam lo shar bar/ mgon khang chen por lor dar gyi bskang gso byed skabs 'dod don phrin las zhu ba 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul rin gyis 'phral du bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
